title: Huffy Recalls Buzz Bicycles Cerana T2 E-Trikes Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The recalled tricycles’ rear wheels can become loose or separate from the rear frame, posing a risk of serious injury from a fall hazard.
description_text: This recall involves Buzz Bicycles Cerana T2 E-Trike, model E4004. The tricycle is a pedal assist tricycle. The tricycle is gray with "BUZZ" logos on the left and right side. The tricycle has a 500-Watt motor and a 48-Volt battery. The tricycle has three 24-inch wheels. The model number is printed on a label near the pedals on the bottom side of the frame’s downtube.

title: Sanven Technology Recalls Vevor BMX Bicycles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Crash Hazard; Violate Federal Requirements for Bicycles
hazard_text: The bicycles violate the mandatory safety regulation for bicycles, because they are not equipped with a chain guard. Loose clothing can get entrapped in the chain drive, posing a risk of serious injury or deadly crash hazard. In addition, the bicycles do not comply with the labeling requirements.
description_text: This recall involves Vevor-branded 20-inch and 24-inch BMX bicycles, models SS24001 and SS24002. The model numbers are printed on the product packaging.  The bicycles were sold in black. The Vevor logo is printed across the downtube of the frame on the bikes.

title: ONOFF S9 Carbon MTB handlebar recalled due to fall and injury hazards
units_text: The company reported that 52 units of the affected products were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The ONOFF S9 Carbon MTB handlebar can crack or fracture during use. If the handlebar breaks while riding, the rider may lose control of the bicycle, posing a fall hazard that may result in serious injury or death. As of ​September 23, 2026​, the company has received no reports of breakage or injury in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves certain Mondraker mountain bicycles equiped with ONOFF S9 Carbon MTB handlebars. The bicycle serial number is located on the underside of the bottom bracket area of the frame. The following products are affected: Mountain Bicycle model Model Year affected Neat RR 2024 Neat RR SL 2025 Dune Carbon XR 2025 Foxy Cabon RR 2025, 2026 Crafty Carbon RR SL 2025, 2026 Crafty Carbon XR 2025, 2026 Craft Carbon RR S 2026 Crafty Unlimited Gulf 2026 Crafty Carbon Unlimited 2026 Level XR 2026 Raze Carbon RR 2026 Zendit RR 2027 Zendit RR S 2027 Zendit XR 2027

title: Giant Bicycle Recalls LED-Light Keys Included with SureLock Bike Lock Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violates Mandatory Standard for Consumer Products with Button Cell Batteries
hazard_text: The LED-light key that was included with certain SureLock Bicycle Lock sets violates the mandatory safety standard for consumer products with button cell and coin batteries because the button batteries can be accessed easily by children, posing an ingestion hazard.  Additionally, the packaging and product do not have the warnings required under Reese's Law. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns, and death.

Only LED-light bike lock keys manufactured after March 2023 are included in this recall. The list of affected serial numbers is included in the table below. title: GIANT SureLock Bicycle Locks with LED Key recalled due to ingestion hazard
units_text: The company reported that 1,395 units of the affected products were sold in Canada and 3,628 were sold in the United States.
hazard_text: The LED key supplied with the affected bicycle locks contains two CR1220 lithium manganese dioxide button/coin cell batteries. The button/coin cell batteries may become accessible from the LED key. If swallowed or inserted into the body, button/coin cell batteries can cause serious internal injuries. The identified hazard is associated with the LED key only. The bicycle lock itself is not affected. Keys supplied with the SureLock bicycle lock other than the LED key are not affected and remain functional. As of September 4, 2026, the company has received no reports of incident or injury in Canada or the United States.
description_text: This recall involves GIANT bicycle locks supplied with an LED key. The LED key contains two CR1220 lithium manganese dioxide button/coin cell batteries. title: Gazelle USA Recalls Urban Arrow Cargo Electric Bikes Due to Fall Hazard
units_text: About 1,032 (In addition, about 134 were sold in Canada)
hazard_text: The front bolt in the seat post clamping mechanism can break, causing the seat to become loose, posing a fall hazard.
description_text: This recall involves Urban Arrow cargo electric bikes with model descriptions Urban Arrow Family (in Black and White), Urban Arrow Shorty (in Black and White), Urban Arrow Cargo L/XL (in Black and White) and Urban Arrow Tender 1000/1500 (in White). The frame of the bicycle is made of aluminum with a reinforced foam (EPP) cargo box. "Urban Arrow" is printed on the bottom of the cargo box. The seat posts on the recalled bicycles have two silver bolts.

title: MONDRAKER USA Recalls Mountain Bicycles Equipped with ONOFF S9 Carbon MTB Handlebars Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fall Hazard
units_text: About 177 (In addition, about 52 were sold in Canada)
hazard_text: The affected handlebars may crack or fracture during use, which can lead to loss of control, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fall hazard.
description_text: This recall involves Certain Mondraker mountain bicycles equipped with ONOFF S9 Carbon MTB handlebars. The ONOFF S9 Carbon MTB handlebar is used as a steering and control component on the bicycle. Bicycles with model numbers CRAFTY CARBON RR S (MY2026), CRAFTY CARBON XR (MY2025-MY2026), CRAFTY CARBON RR SL (MY2025-MY2026), CRAFTY UNLIMITED GULF (MY2026), DUNE CARBON XR (MY2025), FOXY CARBON RR (MY2025-MY2026), LEVEL XR (MY2026), NEAT RR SL (MY2025), ZENDIT R (MY2027), ZENDIT RR (MY2027), ZENDIT RR S (MY2027), ZENDIT XR (MY2027), RAZE CARBON RR (MY2026) and S9 Carbon MTB Handlebar are affected in this recall.

title: Ritchey Design Recalls Carbon Bicycle Forks Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fall and Crash Hazards
hazard_text: The alloy insert located in the front crown hole of the carbon fork can come loose, causing an accessory to fall off and land on the bike's front wheel, posing a risk of serious injury or death from a fall and crash hazard.
description_text: This recall involves Ritchey Carbon Fiber Bicycle Forks with a crown hole. The fork fits on the front of the bicycle to hold the front wheel in place. The fork is sold individually and with certain Ritchey bicycle framesets. The framesets were sold as Montebello (Hot sauce color), Septimer (Black & White color) and Outback (Aurora and Winter Sage color). The individual black carbon forks were sold as WCS Carbon Mountain Adventure Fork, WCS Carbon Brevet Road Fork, WCS Carbon Adventure Gravel Fork and WCS Carbon Tapered Adventure Gravel Fork. The brand name "Ritchey" is located on the fork.

title: Malker Bicycle Light Sets Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion Hazard; Violates Mandatory Standard for Consumer Products with Button Cell Batteries; Sold on Amazon by MalkerDirect
hazard_text: The recalled bicycle lights violate the mandatory standard for consumer products with button cell and coin batteries because they contain button cell batteries that can be accessed easily by children, posing an ingestion hazard. Additionally, the bicycle lights do not have the warnings required under Reese's Law. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death.
description_text: This recall involves Malker Bicycle Light Sets. The bicycle lights were sold in 4- or 8-pack sizes. The products made with red silicone emit red light, products with black silicone emit white light, and products with white silicone emit white light. Each light contains two preinstalled CR2032 button cell batteries. The bicycle lights have "Malker Bicycle Light" printed on labels located on the front packaging. title: Qumeney Bicycle Light Sets Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violates Mandatory Standard for Consumer Products with Button Cell Batteries; Sold on Amazon by Smfanlus
hazard_text: The recalled bicycle lights violate the mandatory standard for consumer products with button cell and coin batteries because they contain button cell batteries that can be accessed easily by children, posing an ingestion hazard. Additionally, the bicycle lights do not have the warnings required under Reese's Law. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns, and death.
description_text: This recall involves Qumeney Bicycle Light Sets, models: BL-01 and BL-02. The bicycle lights are encased in silicone material and available in six colors including: black, white, red, green, yellow and blue. They are sold in packs of six (one of each color) and 24 (four of each color), each light contains two button cell batteries. The bicycle lights have "QUMENEY" printed on the labels located at the top of the package.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Specialized Turbo Como SL Electric Bicycles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The bike's fork steerer tube can develop a small fatigue crack that can lead to a progressive failure of the fork, posing a fall hazard.
description_text: This recall involves bicycle forks on all Specialized Como SL electric bicycles, regardless of model. "Como SL" is printed on the bicycle's seat tube or top tube, and the bikes were sold in a variety of colors, including Cast Umber, Dove Grey and Raspberry (Como SL 4.0), and Smoke, Brassy Yellow and Brushed Silver (Como SL 5.0). You can also determine which model you have by connecting your bicycle to the Specialized app. Only SL versions in the Como family of bicycles are part of this recall.

title: Impulso RC Handlebars recalled due to potential fall hazard
units_text: The company reported that 13 units of the affected products were sold in Canada and 114 were sold in the United States.
hazard_text: The handlebar can break during use, making the bike difficult to steer, and increasing the risk of a fall hazard. As of January 28, 2026, the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada or the United States.
description_text: The recall involves the IMPULSO RC handlebar, which is fitted as standard on IMPULSO RC Bianchi bikes (models YTB84, YUB80, and YUB81) purchased and delivered up to November 20, 2025.

title: Gazelle USA Recalls Urban Arrow FamilyNext Pro Cargo E-Bikes Due to Injury Hazard
hazard_text: The buckle can fail to fully latch when used with children in the cargo area, posing injury hazards to children.
description_text: This recall involves Urban Arrow FamilyNext Pro Cargo E-Bikes with Fidlock buckles. The recalled bicycle comes in one size and comes in green and black. The frame of the bicycle is made of aluminum with a reinforced foam (EPP) cargo box. The bicycle is 105" in length and 28" wide. "Urban Arrow" is imprinted on the bottom of the cargo box.

title: Rear Bolts on Trek and Electra Electric Bicycles Recalled Due to Fall Hazard; Manufactured by Hyena
hazard_text: The rear wheel bolts can break when torqued, causing the wheel to separate from the bicycle, posing a fall hazard.
description_text: This recall involves the rear wheel bolts on model year 2026 Trek-branded FX+ 1 Midstep, FX+ 1S Midstep, FX+ 1 Stepover, and FX+ 1S Stepover, and Electra-branded Townie Go! Step Thru and Townie Go! S Step Thru electric bicycles sold before October 28, 2025. The bicycles come in various colors and sizes. The Trek bicycles have the word "TREK" printed on the downtube of the frame and "FX+" is printed on the top tube. The Electra bicycles have the word "townie" printed on the downtube, "electra" on the seat stay, and "go!" on the chain guard. The original rear wheel bolts are black and connect the motor to the rear frame of the bicycles.

title: PNW Components Loam Pedal Gen 2 bicycle pedals recalled due to fall hazard
units_text: The company reported that 45 units of the affected products were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The pedal axles can crack, causing the pedal to detach from the crank arm, thereby posing a fall hazard to the rider. As of January 14, 2026, the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves PNW Components Loam Pedal Gen 2 aluminum alloy mountain bike pedal. The pedal is a platform style (non-clip) pedal and can be identified by a "Tectonic" logo laser etched onto the pedal body on the left corner, on the same side as the threaded axle. The pedals were sold in silver, black, orange, purple, and green colours.

title: PNW Components Recalls Aluminum Alloy Bicycle Pedals Due to Crash Hazard
hazard_text: The pedal axle can crack, causing the pedal to detach from the crank, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves the PNW Components Loam Pedal Gen 2 aluminum alloy mountain bike pedal. These pedals were sold after market through online retailers and bicycle shops. The pedal is a platform style (non-clip) pedal and can be identified by a "Tectonic" logo laser etched onto the pedal body on the left corner, on the same side as the threaded axle. The pedals are available in black, silver, green, orange and purple.

title: Pedego Electric Bikes Recalls Fat Tire Trikes Due to Fall and Laceration Hazards
hazard_text: The trike frame can develop a hairline fracture near a weld, which can cause the tubes to separate, posing fall and laceration hazards.
description_text: This recall involves the Fat Tire Trike, an aluminum adult three-wheeled electric tricycle. It has a rectangular label on the downtube near the front of the frame with the word "Pedego" printed on it. The product was sold in matte black.

title: TREK Recalls Electric Bicycles Due to Fall or Crash Hazard
hazard_text: The bolts on the chainring can come loose, causing the chainring to separate from the bike, resulting in a fall or crash hazard to the user.
description_text: This recall involves Model Year 2026 Trek-branded Domane+ ALR 5, Domane+ ALR 6 AXS, Checkpoint+ SL 6 and Checkpoint+ SL 7 electric bicycles. The bicycles come in various colors and sizes. The word "TREK" is located on the downtube of the frame on the bicycle, and the model's name is printed on the top tube.

title: Trek and Electra brand bicycles with coaster brakes recalled due to fall hazard

This can cause accelerated wear and internal damage, which may prevent the brake from working. The rider could lose control of the bicycle, posing risk of a fall hazard. title: Lezyne USA Recalls Bicycle Floor Pumps Due to Serious Injury Hazard
units_text: About 7,500 (In addition, about 680 were sold in Canada)
hazard_text: The pump's canister can forcefully eject from the base when pressurized, posing a risk of serious injury from impact to the user or bystander.
description_text: This recall involves two models of Lezyne bicycle floor pumps; the Pressure Over Drive (with analog gauge) and the Digital Pressure Over Drive (with digital gauge). The black tubeless floor pumps are made of steel and aluminum with a natural wood-colored handle and have a nylon-reinforced braided hose. The Lezyne logo is printed on the pump's side. Only floor pumps with a bleed valve on the front of the base are included in this recall.

title: Lezyne bicycle pumps recalled due to injury hazard
units_text: The company reported that 675 units of the affected products were sold in Canada and 7,500 were sold in the United States.
hazard_text: The compression canister of the pump can unexpectedly detach from the base of the pump, causing a potential injury hazard to users. As of October 31, 2025 the company has received no reports of injuries in Canada. In the United States, the company has received one report of injury where the consumer suffered facial injuries when the compression canister become detached from the base.
description_text: This recall involves Lezyne Pressure Over Drive analog and digital floor pumps manufactured between 2017 to 2021. Pumps made after 2021 are not affected. Pumps made before 2021 will have a bleed port on the front of pump base whereas pumps made after 2021 will have the bleed port located on the backside of the pump base.

title: Peloton Original Series Bike+ Model PL02 Seat Post recalled due to potential fall hazard
units_text: The Company reported that approximately 44,800 units of the affected product were sold in Canada and approximately 833,000 were sold in the United States.
hazard_text: The Original Series Bike+'s seat post assembly can break during use, posing fall and injury hazards to the user. As of November 6th, 2025, the company has received no reported incidents in Canada. In the United States, the company has received three reports of the seat post breaking during use.
description_text: This recall involves certain seat posts on Peloton Original Series Bike+ units with model number PL02 and serial numbers beginning with the letter “T”. The bike measures 4 ft. long x 2 ft. wide and has an adjustable seat and handlebar. The Peloton name and the model number appear inside the front fork, behind the front fork, or behind the flywheel. Information to help locate your Bike+ serial number is available here.

title: Knog Recalls Bicycle Lights Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
hazard_text: The lithium-ion battery in the bicycle light can overheat and catch fire, posing a risk of fire and burn hazards.
description_text: This recall involves the Knog Blinder 900 and Blinder 1300 Front Bicycle Lights with the following batch codes: 0124AA, 0423AA, 0723AA, 0923AA, 1023AA, 1123AA and 11A23AA. The batch codes are printed on the underside of the light. They have a black exterior and are marked with the brand "knog". The word "Blinder" is imprinted on the light's handle. They were sold individually, and in a set, and came with a mount. Note: Do not throw this recalled lithium-ion battery or device in the trash, the general recycling stream (e.g., street-level or curbside recycling bins), or used battery recycling boxes found at various retail and home improvement stores. Recalled lithium-ion batteries must be disposed of differently than other batteries, because they present a greater risk of fire. Your municipal household hazardous waste (HHW) collection center may accept this recalled lithium-ion battery or device for disposal. Before taking your battery or device to a HHW collection center, contact that office ahead of time and ask whether it accepts recalled lithium-ion batteries. If it does not, contact your municipality for further guidance.

title: DT Swiss carbon fiber wheelsets recalled due to fall hazard
units_text: The company reported that 148 units of the affected products were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The carbon fiber can delaminate, which could cause the rim to deform. This could cause the rider to lose control of the bicycle, posing a fall hazard. As of July 15th, 2025, the company has received no reports of the rims delaminating in Canada, and no reports of injuries.
description_text: This recall involves DT Swiss carbon fiber bicycle wheelsets, made up of DT Swiss stainless steel spokes, DT Swiss aluminum hubs, and carbon fiber rims. Models ERC, CRC, HEC and ARC with DT Swiss ID numbers of 2750000 and higher are affected. The rims are black (carbon fiber) and show the product model categories on the side of the rim of ERC, CRC, HEC, or ARC.

title: The Government of Canada is assisting Giant Bicycle Canada Inc. in communicating the Momentum Vida E+ model e-bicycle recall
units_text: The company reported that 1,446 units of the affected products were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The fork steerer tube on the recalled e-bicycles can crack, break or separate during use, posing a fall hazard. As of July 22, 2025, the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada. In the United States, the company has received four reports of broken fork steerer tubes and no reports of injuries.
description_text: This recall involves the Momentum Vida E+ e-bicycles. The bicycles come in metallic red, pearl white, metallic navy blue, metallic green, indigo blue and happy mint. Bikes with a serial number in which the third character is "H", "J" or "K" are included in this recall and must have their forks replaced free of charge. Bikes with a serial number in which the third character is “G” require additional visual inspection by an authorized Giant Bicycle dealer to determine fork status.

hazard_text: Multiple components of the children's bicycles contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban, posing a lead poisoning hazard to children. title: Canyon Bicycles USA Recalls Speedmax CF Triathlon Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
units_text: About 1,400 (In addition, about 380 were sold in Canada)
hazard_text: The aerostem fork steerer tube on the recalled bicycles can crack or break, posing fall and injury hazard.
description_text: This recall involves all Canyon Speedmax CF triathlon bicycle models R073 and R41 with V21 aerostems. title: Super73 Recalls Z Miami SE and Z Adventure Core Electric Bicycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
hazard_text: The retaining pin in the e-bike's disc brake calipers can loosen and dislodge from the caliper assembly, resulting in brake failure, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves Super73's model year 2024 Z Miami SE (900-00288, 900-00309 and 900-00313) and Z Adventure Core (900-00308) electric bicycles. The Z Miami SE e-bikes were sold in three colors: Bandit black with a black seat; Palladium gray with a camel seat; and Astro Orange with a black seat. The Z Adventure Core e-bikes come in only one color: Sandstorm, which has a black and brown frame. The model name and color are on the purchase receipt.

title: Trek Recalls Electra E-Bikes Due to Crash Hazard
hazard_text: The rear fender can come loose and can contact the rear wheel and stop the bike unexpectedly, causing the rider to lose control of the bike, posing a crash hazard.
description_text: This recall involves Electra Navigator Go! (Model years 2021 and 2022) and Electra Ace of Spades Go! e-bikes (Model years 2018, 2021 and 2022). The Electra Navigator Go! comes in Matte Nautilus Blue with map/ocean graphics and the Ace of Spades Go! comes in Matte Black with a gold spade. The name "Electra" is printed on the down tube and chain guard of the Ace of Spades Go! with a spade on the top tube.

title: Canyon Speedmax Bikes recalled due to injury hazard
units_text: The company reported that 383 units of the affected products were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: Canyon Speedmax CF models R073 and R41 with a V21 Aerostem can, in rare instances, sustain a crack or break of the fork steerer tube, leading to a potential detachment of the cockpit assembly (stem and handlebar), mostly after a harsh impact such as hitting a deep pothole or another similar stress event. This might lead to a fall or in severe cases, injury depending on the situation and the rider’s environmental conditions. As of February 12, 2025, the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves Canyon Speedmax CF bike models R073 and R41 equipped with V21 Aerostem.

title: woom OFF, OFF AIR and ORIGINAL bicycles recalled due to fall hazard
units_text: The company reported that 29 units of the affected products were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The crank can break due to fatigue fractures causing the rider to lose control, posing fall and crash hazards. As of November 18, 2024, the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves OFF 5, OFF AIR 5, OFF 6, and OFF AIR 6 bicycles from model years 2019 to 2020 and the ORIGINAL 6 bicycles from model years 2016 to 2020. title: woom Bikes USA Recalls Children's OFF, OFF AIR and ORIGINAL 6 Bicycles Due to Fall and Crash Hazards
hazard_text: The crank can break, due to fatigue fractures, causing the rider to lose control, posing fall and crash hazards.

title: Devinci Chainsaw and Chainsaw DH alloy bikes recalled due to injury hazard
units_text: The company reported that 500 units of the affected products were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The frames on affected bikes may crack, causing the head tube to separate from the top tube, resulting in an injury hazard. As of October 28, 2024, the company has received 3 reports of incidents in Canada, and no reported injuries.
description_text: This recall involves Devinci Chainsaw and Chainsaw DH alloy bike models with UPC 8712000050. description_text: This recall involves all sizes of woom ORIGINAL 2018 - 2021 model bikes. The stems on these bikes have one silver bolt to clamp onto the steerer tube. The markings "#woombikes" in black letters on chain stay and wheel size in black on sides of the front fork.

title: Bunch Bikes Recalls The Preschool Electric Bicycles Due to Violation of the Federal Lead Paint Ban; Lead Poisoning Hazard (Recall Alert)
hazard_text: The paint on the recalled electric bikes contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban, posing a lead poisoning hazard. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues.
description_text: This recall involves the Preschool front-loading electric cargo tricycle that seats up to six children on bench-style seats in the passenger area. The recalled bikes are painted with a yellow exterior and black interior color with a high-gloss finish. The recalled bikes have the Bunch logo on the side of the passenger box and were sold as The Preschool 2020 edition starting in 2020, The Preschool and then The Preschool 3.0. The rear half of the frame uses rectangular tubing and the handlebars are mounted on both the left and right side of the passenger box.

title: Shimano Recalls PRO Vibe Alloy Stems for Road Bicycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
units_text: About 400 (In addition, about 90 were sold in Canada)
hazard_text: The recalled bicycle stems can crack and break while in use and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of injury to the user in a crash.
description_text: This recall involves PRO Vibe Stem (Alloy) model black bicycle stems for road bicycles. The PRO Vibe stems were sold separately and installed by bicycle stores. The recalled stems have a silver 'V' logo on the faceplate of the stem and the forward-facing mounting bolts.

title: Shimano PRO Vibe Bicycle Stem recalled due to injury hazard
units_text: The company reported that 90 units of the affected product were sold in Canada and 400 were sold in the United States.
hazard_text: The stems may form cracks and break over time causing the rider to lose control and fall, posing a risk of injury. As of April 21, 2023, the company has received no reports of incidents in Canada, and no reports of injuries. In the United States, the company has received 2 reports of incidents and no reports of injuries.
description_text: This recall involves Shimano PRO Vibe bicycle stems. The stems can be identified by its black coloured alloy with a prominent silver “V” branding on the faceplate of the stem. The stem has forward facing mounting bolts. Models with bolt heads at the front of the faceplate are not subject to this recall.

title: Peloton Bike Model PL01 Seat Post recalled due to potential fall and injury hazard
units_text: The company reported that approximately 108,000 of the affected product were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The bike’s seat post assembly can break during use, posing fall and injury hazards to the user. The issue has occurred primarily in users who are taller than 5’11” (180 cm) and above 250 pounds (114 kg). As of May 11th, 2023, the company has received 1 reported incident and no reports of injury in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves Peloton Bikes with model number PL01. The bike measures 1.2 meters (4 feet) long and 0.6 meters (2 feet) wide, and has an adjustable seat, handlebar, and screen, which tilts up and down to accommodate different heights. The Peloton name and the model number are displayed on the inside front fork, near the flywheel.

title: Bicycles and Framesets Recalled Due to Crash Hazard; Manufactured by Open Cycle
hazard_text: The rear brake can fail, posing a crash hazard.
description_text: This recall involves Open Cycle-branded bicycles, models U.P. Ekar, UPPER Ekar, WIDE Ekar and MIND Ekar; and all Open Cycle framesets using a Campagnolo hydraulic rear disc brake. They were sold in matte black, blue, gray, orange or a custom color. Only bicycles and framesets with Campagnolo hydraulic brakes and hoses are included in this recall. The "OPEN" logo is located on the top of the downtube and the model name on the top of the top tube, near the seat tube.

title: Cannondale Recalls Tesoro Neo X Speed Electric Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
hazard_text: The bicycles do not meet the U.S. safety standard; the hand brakes are configured in accordance with the European safety standard which is reversed from the U.S. safety standard, posing fall and injury hazards to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves the Cannondale Tesoro Neo X Speed electric bicycles (e-bikes). The e-bikes have an electric assist motor and are equipped with a horn, mirror, headlights and brake lights. "Cannondale" is printed on the sides of the top tube of the bicycle frame and on the sides of the seat. The e-bikes are gray with reflective accents on the frame, and tires and were sold in sizes small, medium, large and extra-large.

title: Linus Bike Recalls Electric Bicycles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
hazard_text: The bicycle's front fork can crack, posing a crash hazard.

title: E-Bikes Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Distributed by Gyroor (Recall Alert)
hazard_text: The e-bike's battery pack can ignite, posing fire and burn hazards.

title: Various Thule Camber and Thule Range hitch bike carriers recalled due to injury hazard

description_text: This recall involves Rad Power Bikes's RadWagon 4 Electric Cargo Bikes (ebikes) which were sold in black, white and orange colors. The name "RADWAGON" is printed on the side of the upper downtube of the ebike frame and "RAD POWER BIKES" is printed on the lower downtube of the frame. The ebike has two tires (front and rear). hazard_text: The lithium-ion batteries can ignite, explode or spark, posing fire, explosion and burn hazards to consumers.
description_text: This recall involves Ancheer e-bikes with model number AM001907. The model number can be found on the e-bike packaging and in the instruction manual but cannot be found on the bike itself. A water bottle shaped cylindrical battery distinguishes model AM001907 from other models. The bikes are black and have 26-inch wheels. "Ancheer" is printed on the downtube.

title: Swift Industries Recalls Rubber Straps for Swift Bicycle Bags Due to Crash and Injury Hazard
hazard_text: The rubber straps that fasten the bicycle bag to the bicycle can break causing the bag to come loose and fall, posing crash hazard and injury hazards to the rider.

title: Rockgeist Recalls BarJam Brackets Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
hazard_text: The recalled bracket arms, attached to bicycle handlebars, can crack or break during use, causing the harness and gear to fall while the bicycle is in motion, posing a crash and injury hazards.

title: Brompton Bicycle Recalls Foldable Electric Bicycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
units_text: About 2,230 (In addition, about 110 were sold in Canada)
hazard_text: The mudguard is positioned too close to the front wheel which can cause the wheel to lock up leading to sudden deceleration of the bike if an object gets caught between the mudguard and front tire, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves Brompton foldable electric bicycles with 16-inch wheels, sold in black, white, bolt lacquer, Turkish green, and white/gold colors. "Brompton" is printed on the center tube of the bike's frame. Recalled models include the Brompton Electric M2L, H2L, M6L, and H6L which are printed on the bicycles name plate, which is affixed to the bottom of the seat-post facing rearwards.

title: Santa Cruz Bicycles Recalls Heckler 9 Electric Bicycles Due to Fall and Fire Hazards
hazard_text: The latch mechanism that holds the battery in place can malfunction, causing the battery to dislodge from the frame and fall to the ground, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Additionally, the latch spring can cause additional wear on the battery housing over time, posing a fire hazard.
description_text: This recall involves 2022 Santa Cruz Heckler 9 model electric bicycles (e-bikes), which were sold in Gloss Avocado Green or Maritime Gray colors. They come with an interchangeable 720WH battery that sits inside a black case under the frame. The name "SANTA CRUZ" is printed on the sides of the downtube of the bicycle frame, and "Heckler" is printed on the top tube of the frame and on the inside of the left chainstay on the frame.

title: WizWheelz Recalls GreenSpeed Magnum Recumbent Trikes with Quick Release Axles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
hazard_text: The recalled recumbent trikes front axles were improperly assembled during manufacturing. The axles can come loose during use, causing the rider to lose control, posing crash and injury hazards.
description_text: This recall involves GreenSpeed Magnum and Magnum XL model recumbent trikes with Sturmey-Archer drum brake quick release front axles. Magnum or Magnum XL are printed on the trikes. Sturmey-Archer is printed on the hub/wheel where the axle is attached. Serial numbers P21276160 through P21460262 are included in this recall. The recalled trikes are orange, blue or charcoal in color with a black seat and three wheels. The serial numbers are printed on the left dropout, which is a slot in the rear of the bike where the rear wheel attaches. Consumers can check their serial numbers at https://greenspeed-trikes.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/GreenSpeed-Magnum-Magnum-XL-Axle-Recall-Serial-Numbers-UPDATED.pdf

title: Expanded Recall: Specialized-branded Sirrus bicycles with alloy cranks recalled due to fall hazard
hazard_text: The crank arm can disengage and cause the bicycle’s rider to lose control, posing fall and injury hazards. As of August 31, 2022, the company has received 5 reports of incidents in Canada with reports of minor injuries.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Tarmac SL7 Bicycles and Framesets Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
hazard_text: The bicycle's fork steerer tube can crack or break after harsh impact such as hitting a deep pothole or other stress event, posing fall and injury hazards to riders.
description_text: This recall involves Specialized Tarmac SL7 bicycles and framesets. "Tarmac" is written on the back of the bicycle's seat tube. There is an integrated (hidden) cable routing through the bicycle's headset. "Specialized" or "SWORKS" are printed on the bicycle's downtube.

title: Specialized Tarmac SL7 Bicycles recalled due to fall hazard
units_text: The company reported that approximately 415 units of the affected product were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: Harsh frontal impacts, e.g., impacting a deep pothole, may put extraordinary stress on headset components and cause the fork's steerer tube to crack. A damaged fork may pose a fall hazard to the rider. As of September 23, 2021, the company has received one incident report and no report of injuries in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves Specialized SL7 bicycles. The bicycles will say either Specialized or S-Works on the downtube and Tarmac on the back of the seat tube. SL7 models can be distinguished from older generation Tarmac models by their integrated (hidden) cable routing through the headset. For more information on how to identify affected bicycles, consumers should visit the company's website at www.specialized.com/safety-notices. Model Year 2020-2021 Tarmac SL7 bicycles are affected by this recall.

title: ElliptiGO Recalls Arc Model Stand-Up Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
units_text: About 3,800 (In addition, about 31 were sold in Canada)

description_text: This recall involves the three models of ElliptiGO Arc bicycles: ElliptiGO Arc 3, ElliptiGO Arc 8 and ElliptiGO Arc 24. The Arc 3 model has three gears. The Arc 8 model has eight gears. The Arc 24 model has 24 gears. ElliptiGO Arc bicycles are composed of an aluminum frame with the words "ElliptiGO" and "Arc" displayed on each side, a front fork, a steering column attached to handlebars, foot platforms situated on drive arms that are attached to swing arms, a front wheel and a rear wheel, front and rear brakes and a variety of other components.

title: ElliptiGO Arc 3, Arc 8, Arc 24 Bicycles recalled due to Fall Hazard
units_text: The company reported that 31 units of the affected product were sold in Canada and 3,700 were sold in the United States.
hazard_text: The frame of the bicycle can fail, posing a fall hazard to the rider. As of September 3, 2021, the company has received 1 report of the frame failing in Canada, and 1 report of minor injuries. In the United States, the company has received 11 reports of the frame failing during use, and 6 reports of minor injuries.
description_text: The recalled bicycles have the markings "ElliptiGO" on both sides of the main frame tube. The word "Arc" is decaled on both sides of the rear portion of the frame. The Arc 3 has one gear indicator and displays the number "3". The Arc 8 has one gear indicator and displays the number "8". The Arc 24 has 2 gear indicators, one on each side of the handlebar.

title: Rocky Mountain Instinct, Instinct BC and Pipeline aluminum mountain bikes recalled due to Fall Hazard
units_text: Approximately 1466 units of the affected product were sold in Canada and approximately 1527 were sold in the United States.
hazard_text: The front triangle of the bicycle frame can crack, causing the steering tube to separate from the frame, posing a risk of injury and fall hazard to the user. In Canada, as of June 25th, 2020 the company has received 12 reports of the bicycle frame cracking and no reports of injuries.
description_text: This recall involves Rocky Mountain brand Instinct, Instinct BC and Pipeline alloy (aluminum) mountain bikes from 2018, 2019 and 2020. The affected bicycles in sizes small and medium have serial numbers beginning with PRK17, PRK18 or PRK19. Affected bicycles in size large have serial numbers beginning with PRK17, PRK18 or between PRK19-00001 and PRK19-01275. The serial number is engraved under the pedal housing. Models with carbon frames are not included in the recall.

title: Giant Pinner DH and VP Harrier bicycle pedals recalled due to fall hazard
units_text: Approximately 364 units of the affected product were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The locking fastener can fail allowing the pedal to slide off the spindle, posing a potential fall hazard to the rider. As of May 4, 2020, the company has received 20 reports of the pedal detaching in Canada, and one report of injury.
description_text: The Giant Pinner DH pedals have the "Giant" logo marking on them. The VP Harrier pedals are marked with "Harrier". The locking fasteners at the end of the spindles are attached flush to the pedals. Giant Pinner DH and VP Harrier pedals that have locking fasteners protruding at the end of the spindle are NOT included in this recall.

title: VP Harrier and Giant Pinner Bicycle Pedals Recalled Due to Fall and Injury Hazards; Made by VP Components
units_text: About 5,400 (2,700 pairs) Harrier and Giant Pinner DH pedals
hazard_text: The pedal body can separate from the pedal spindle resulting in a loss of balance, posing fall and injury hazards for the rider.
description_text: This recall involves VP Components Harrier and Giant Pinner DH bicycle pedals. The pedals were sold separately from bicycles. A spindle extends through the pedal body. One end of the spindle is attached to the end of the crank arm of the bicycle. The other end of the spindle is secured to the pedal body with a fastener. The pedals are red, silver or black-colored with Harrier or Giant printed on the pedal body.

title: Woom bikes USA Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
hazard_text: The bicycle's front fork can loosen and detach, posing fall and injury risks to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves woom bicycle models 4 (20 inch), 5 (24 inch) and 6 (26 inch). You can find the model number on the top tube of each bike. The bikes were sold in five different colors: Red, blue, green, purple and yellow. "Woom" is printed across the bottom tube of the bicycle frame.

title: BTWIN Baby Seat 100 BCLIP for bicycles recalled due to a fall hazard
units_text: Approximately 115 units of the affected product were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The attachment point of the child's buckle can break and the child can slip out of the seat, posing a fall hazard. As of January 10, 2020, Décathlon Canada Inc. has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves the BTWIN Baby Seat 100 BCLIP for bicycles. The child bicycle seat has a black plastic outer shell with footrest and a blue inner seat cushion with black straps. The model number 8486914 and item number 2538309 can be found on the instruction manual.

title: BMC Recalls Bicycles and Framesets Due to Fall Hazard
units_text: About 840 (In addition, 94 were sold in Canada)
hazard_text: The fork steerer tube on the bicycles and framesets can crack or break during use, posing a fall hazard.
description_text: This recall involves all model year 2018 and 2019 Teammachine SLR01 DISC bicycles and framesets. The product is a performance road bike. BMC is printed on the downtube. The bikes and framesets were sold in red, green, grey, graphite, blue and aqua green. Recalled models contain serial numbers starting with 8R17 and 8R18, followed by one letter and a four-digit code, which is printed on the underside of the bottom bracket of the bicycle. Only bicycles and framesets with a FK6 fork require a replacement fork, which will be confirmed by BMC authorized dealers during the free inspection. As of December, 2019, the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada. title: Profile Design Recalls Bicycle Carbon Aerobars Due to Crash Hazard
hazard_text: The bicycle aerobars can crack and break, causing the rider to lose control and crash.
description_text: This recall involves Profile Design Aeria Ultimate carbon aerobars sold individually and as an original equipment upgrade on consumer configurable Dimond Brand Bikes and Quintana Roo model bicycles. The aerobars were sold in one size and are all matte black in color. "Profile Design" and "Ultimate" are embossed in gloss black on the top of the rear edge of the aerobars. The best way to identify recalled handlebars is to measure the uncut hand extensions from the leading edge of wing to tip of hand extension (where brake lever is placed). On recalled bars it is 13.6 cm (5.3 in) measured from leading edge of wing.

title: Surly Bikes Recalls Bicycle Racks Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
hazard_text: The recalled front bicycle rack can loosen and contact the front wheel, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves all Surly 8-Pack Racks and Surly 24-Pack front bicycle racks and Pack Rat Bicycles equipped with these racks. The racks were sold in black and silver finishes, are made of tubular chromoly steel and are intended for use on the front of a bicycle.

title: Trek Recalls Super Commuter+ Electric Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The front fender bolt can unthread causing the wheel to detach from the bicycle, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves all model year 2017, 2018, and 2019 Trek Super Commuter+ 8S electric bicycles. "Trek" is printed on the bicycle's downtube and the bike has an integrated battery and motor. The bikes were sold in the following color and sizes: Viper Red with black decals, sizes 45/S through 60/XL.

title: Btwin bike carrier adaptor bar recalled due to risk of injury
units_text: Approximately 24 units of the affected product were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The security arm holding the bike in place could open and cause the bike to fall. As of December 2, 2019, the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves Btwin bike carrier adaptor bars. The product model code is 8357813, the part number is 2033547 and the bar code is 3608409911964.

title: Surly Bicycle Racks recalled due to crash or injury hazard
units_text: Approximately 457 units of the affected product were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The recalled front bicycle rack can loosen and contact the front wheel, posing a crash or injury hazard to the user As of December 2, 2019, Surly has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada. In the United States, Surly has received 18 reports of racks failing, including seven reports of minor injuries including sprains and lacerations, and five reports of serious injuries including a fractured vertebra.
description_text: This recall involves all Surly 8-Pack bicycle racks and Surly 24-Pack bicycle racks and Pack Rat Bicycles equipped with these racks. The racks have black and silver finishes and are made of tubular Chromoly steel. They are intended for use on the front of a bicycle.

title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls Cannondale CAADX Cyclocross Bicycles Due to Fall and Serious Injury Hazard; One Fatality Reported
units_text: About 9,700 (in addition, about 1,900 were sold in Canada)
hazard_text: The fork can break, posing a fall hazard with the risk of death and serious injury.
description_text: This recall involves model year 2013 through 2016 Cannondale CAADX Cyclocross bicycles equipped with disc brakes. Cyclocross racing combines both off-road and on-road cycling. The bicycles were sold in a variety of colors and configurations. Consumers should inspect their bicycle to determine if it is affected by this recall by confirming: (1) The bicycle has a prominent CAADX marking on the top tube or other location. (2) The bicycle has disc brakes. (3) The inside of the fork leg has a large "ULTRAX" marking. (4) The cable running to the front disc brake is outside of the fork, as opposed to inside the fork. For assistance determining if a bicycle is affected, consumers should bring it to a Cannondale authorized dealer.

title: Cycling Sports Group recalls Cannondale CAADX Cyclocross bicycles due to fall hazard
units_text: Approximately 1919 units of the affected product were sold in Canada and approximately 9700 were sold in the United States.
hazard_text: The bicycle fork can fracture, which can allow the wheel to detach from the bicycle during use, posing a fall hazard to riders. As of July 2, 2019, Cycling Sports Group Inc. has received 11 reports of incidents worldwide, with 7 reports of injuries, including concussions and a spinal injury and one fatality. Of these reported incidents, one occurred in Canada and five occurred in the United States.
description_text: This recall involves model year 2013 through 2016 Cannondale CAADX Cyclocross bicycles equipped with disc brakes. The bicycles were sold in a variety of colors and configurations. Consumers should inspect their bicycle to determine if it is affected by this recall by confirming: The bicycle has a prominent CAADX marking on the top tube or other location. The bicycle has disc brakes. The inside of the fork leg has a large "ULTRAX" marking. The cable connected to the front disc brake is completely outside the fork blade. Later models, not subject to recall, have the cable connected to the front disc brake routed internally, inside the structure of the fork blade.

title: Trek Recalls Kickster Bikes Due to Fall Hazard
units_text: About 11,560 (In addition, 1,800 were sold in Canada)
hazard_text: The steer tube clamp on the bike can break, posing a fall hazard to children.
description_text: This recall involves all model year 2013 through 2019 Trek Kicksters. The bikes are made for toddlers who are learning how to ride a two wheeler. The kicksters do not have pedals so children can focus on balancing. They come in black, blue, red and pink and "TREK" is written on the crossbar.

title: Trek Kickster Balance Bicycle recalled due to fall hazard
units_text: Approximately 1,824 units of the affected product were sold in Canada and approximately 11,555 units were sold in the United States.
hazard_text: The steer tube clamp may break, which may result in the handlebars coming off, presenting a potential fall hazard. As of July 22, 2019, the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada. Globally, Trek Bicycle Corporation has received 11 reports of broken clamps. In the United States, the company has received 8 reports of broken steer tube clamps, and 1 report of scratching and bruising.
description_text: This recall involves all SKUs of Trek Kickster Balance Bicycles with model years 2013 to 2019. The bicycles are made of aluminum with handlebars, two wheels and no pedals and come in various colours.

title: Ghost Nivolet X 5 LC 28 bicycle recalled due to fall hazard
units_text: Approximately 50 units of the affected product were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The carbon forks on these road bikes can break posing a fall hazard. As of June 20, 2019, MEC has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves the 2017 model of Ghost Nivolet X 5 LC 28 bicycle that was sold by Mountain Equipment Co-op (MEC). Only 2017 models sold by MEC with disk brakes within the G number range of GC0000932 to GC0001506, and GHQ557994 are affected. The G number of the bicycle is located on the bottom bracket shell of the bicycle as shown.

title: Electric Bicycles Recalled by Faraday; Seat Post Poses Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The seat post on the bicycles can break, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves seat posts for four Faraday bicycle models, Porteur, Porteur S, Cortland, Cortland S. The words "HL" or "Zoom" are engraved on the seat post. The bikes were sold in various colors including Classic White, British Racing Green, Tungsten, Slate Gray, Midnight Run, Stingray Blue, Seafoam and Coral.

title: SRAM Recalls RockShox Front Suspension Forks Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
units_text: About 840 (In addition, about 80 were sold in Canada)
hazard_text: The fork's lower leg assembly can break and cause the rider to lose control, posing crash and injury hazards.
description_text: This recall involves RockShox Lyrik and RockShox Yari front suspension forks with serial numbers 02T95514009 through 08T96214665. A bicycle fork is the part that holds the front wheel. The recalled forks are black or black and red and are for 29" bicycle wheels. RockShox is printed on the side of the fork and casting code 18 and O or 19 and A is embossed inside the webbing of the arch. The serial number can be found on the rear of the fork crown. The forks were sold as aftermarket equipment and as original equipment on the following mountain bicycle brands and models: BRAND MODEL Kona Process153 29 Process 153 DL 29 Process 153 CR 29 Process 153 CR DL 29 Process 165 29 Santa Cruz Megatower 29 Trek Powerfly LT 7 US Powerfly LT 9.7 US Scott Ransom 930

title: SRAM (RockShox) Lyrik and Yari front suspension forks for bicycles recalled due to fall hazard
units_text: Approximately 79 units of the affected product were sold in Canada and approximately 841 were sold in the United States.
hazard_text: The bicycle forks can fatigue prematurely and break, which may cause the rider to lose control and fall. As of June 04, 2019, the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada or the United States.
description_text: This recall involves SRAM (RockShox) Lyrik and Yari front suspension forks for 29” bicycle wheels. Forks within the serial number range of 02T95514009 to 08T96214665 and having a fork lower with a casting code of "18" and "O" or "19" and "A" are affected. The serial number can be found on the rear of the fork crown. The casting code can be seen inside the webbing of the arch as shown.

title: Argon 18 racing bicycles recalled due to injury hazard
units_text: Approximately 280 affected products were sold in Canada
hazard_text: If the saddle (seat) mounting screw is tightened beyond the recommended setting, there is a possibility the over-torqued screw will bend and may break, posing an injury hazard to the rider. As of May 28, 2019 there have been no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves the following models of Argon 18 racing bicycles: Gallium Pro 2018/19 Gallium Pro Disc 2017/18/19 Gallium 2019 Gallium Disc 2019 The model name is printed on the bicycle frame top tube and fork.

title: Revelate Designs Recalls Bicycle Seat Bags Due to Crash, Injury Hazards
hazard_text: The straps that fasten the bag to the bike seat can detach and get entangled in the rear wheel of the bike, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves Revelate Designs 2019 Terrapin System 14L model bicycle seat bags. The seat bags have a pair of straps with hooks on the top rear of the bag and 4 red loops which the hooks connect to. The bags have Revelate Design logos on the left and right sides and were sold in black, blue, purple and camoflauge. The nylon bags measure about 18 inches by 7 inches

title: Stromer ST5 Electric Bicycles recalled due to Crash Hazard
units_text: Approximately 7 units of the affected product were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The bicycle stem can break, posing a crash hazard to the rider. As of May 17th, 2019 the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves all Stromer ST5 pedal-assisted bicycles sold in a black or gray aluminum frame. The e-bikes have hydraulic disc brakes, an integrated lithium battery located inside the down tube, a motor on the rear hub and a three-button switch on the handlebars. Stromer is printed on the top tube of the bicycle frame and on the seat and chain guard. ST5 is printed on the downtube. Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) TBNST5S700SJA0001 through TBNST5S700SKF0065 is etched on the bottom of the right-side chainstay.

title: Specialized Recalls Bicycles with Steerer Tube Collars Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
hazard_text: The bicycle's steerer tube collar can crack if exposed to corrosion resulting in sudden loss of steering control, posing fall and injury hazards to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves select Specialized Roubaix, Ruby, Diverge and Sirrus bicycles equipped with a Future Shock from the 2017 through 2019 model years. The bikes come in a variety of colors and include S-works, Pro, Expert, Comp, Elite, E5 Comp, Sport and Base models. An S-works or Specialized decal can be found on the downtube.

title: Quality Bicycle Products Recalls Bicycles Due To Injury Hazard
hazard_text: The bicycle's fork legs can break, posing an injury hazard.
description_text: This recall involves all 2019 Salsa Warbird Carbon series bicycles and framesets, including Ultegra Di2, Force 1, 105, Apex 1, and Tiagra bicycles and all 2019 Salsa Vaya 105 bicycles and framesets. The model name is printed on the frame of the bicycles. The bicycles are sold in a variety of different colors and sizes. title: myStromer Recalls Electric Bicycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
hazard_text: The bicycle stem can break, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves all Stromer ST5 pedal-assist electric bicycles. They were sold in a black or gray aluminum frame. The e-bikes have hydraulic disc brakes, an integrated lithium battery located inside the down tube, a motor on the rear hub and a three-button switch on the handlebars. Stromer is printed on the top tube of the bicycle frame and on the seat and chain guard. ST5 is printed on the downtube. Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) TBNST5S700SJA0001 through TBNST5S700SKF0065 is etched on the bottom of the right-side chainstay.

title: SRAM Recalls Bicycle Gear Hubs Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
units_text: About 7,000 (in addition, 700 were sold in Canada)
hazard_text: The brakes in the gear hubs can fail, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves SRAM® i-Motion 3 three-speed internal gear hubs with a coaster brake installed on bicycles with no redundant braking system. The recalled hubs were sold on the following Electra® model bicycles: Electra Cruiser Custom 3i, Electra Coaster 3i, Electra Hawaii 3i, Electra Hawaii 3i 24 and Electra Straight 8. The recalled hubs were also sold as aftermarket parts for other bicycles. The recalled hubs have "SRAM i-Motion 3" printed on the hub shell and a brake arm extending from the axle of the hub.

title: SRAM recalls three-speed internal gear hub with coaster brake
units_text: Approximately 700 units of the affected products were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The brake can fail, posing a crash or fall hazard to the rider. As of January 3, 2019, the company has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada. In the United States, the company has received 4 reports of crashes or falls, and 1 report of a knee and ankle injury from a fall.
description_text: This recall involves SRAM i-Motion 3, three-speed internal gear hub with coaster brake, UPC 710845662782, for a bicycle. The internal gear hub was sold installed on the following models of bicycles (with no redundant braking system - for example no front brake): Electra Cruiser Custom 3i Electra Coaster 3i Electra Hawaii 3i Electra Hawaii 3i (24") Electra Straight 8

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Canada, Inc. recalls select Specialized-Branded Bicycles with Steerer Tube Collars
units_text: Approximately 4,900 units of the affected products were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The steerer tube collar on the affected products may crack if exposed to corrosion which may cause the rider to loose control, posing fall and injury hazards. As of December 18, 2018, the company has not received any reports of incidents in Canada, and no report of injuries.
description_text: This recall involves select Specialized-branded Roubaix, Ruby, Diverge, and Sirrus bicycles. Below is a list of affected products by model year: Affected Specialized-branded bicycles by model year and product name 2017 ROUBAIX RUBY S-WORKS X X PRO X X EXPERT X X COMP X X ELITE X X Affected Specialized-branded bicycles by model year and product name 2018 ROUBAIX RUBY DIVERGE SIRRUS S-WORKS X X X PRO X X EXPERT X X X X COMP X X X E5 COMP X SPORT X X X ELITE X X BASE X X Affected Specialized-branded bicycles by model year and product name 2019 ROUBAIX RUBY DIVERGE SIRRUS S-WORKS X X X PRO X X EXPERT X X X X COMP X X X X E5-COMP X SPORT X X X BASE X X X The product names are printed on the bicycle frame.

title: TerraTrike Recalls Adult Tricycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
hazard_text: The torque sensor in the wheel can activate unexpectedly and cause the trike to power forward, posing crash and injury hazards.
description_text: This recall involves yellow TerraTrike Rambler Electrical Vehicle Option ( E.V.O.) recumbent pedal-powered trikes with an electric assist wheel. The trikes have two wheels in the front and one wheel in the back with a large black hub motor. "Terra Trike" is printed on the front of the back rest area. The model name "Rambler E.V.O." is located on the front outrigger tube that connects to the front left wheel. The serial numbers included in this recall are listed on the firm's website at www.terratrike.com and are located under the main tube on a barcoded sticker near the rear wheel. The serial numbers are also stamped into the head (vertical) tube of the outrigger.

title: Öhlins Recalls Bicycle Forks Sold on Specialized Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
units_text: About 5,400 (In addition, about 550 were sold in Canada)
hazard_text: The air cartridge can abruptly spring out of the stanchion tube, posing fall and injury risks to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves Öhlins branded RXF36 Air and RXF34 Air suspension forks sold as aftermarket equipment and as original equipment on some Specialized-branded Enduro, Stumpjumper, Fuse, and Levo mountain bicycles. A bicycle fork is the part that holds the front wheel. The recalled forks are black with "ÖHLINS" written in gold on each of the fork lowers. They have "RXF36" or "RXF34" printed across the fork arch. RXF36 Coil Forks (no air valve on the right-side top cap and "TTX" and "Coil" written on the back of the left fork lowers) are not included in this recall.

title: ÖHLINS RACING AB recalls Front Air Suspension Bicycle Forks
units_text: Approximately 550 units of the affected bicycle forks were sold in Canada and approximately 5,400 were sold in the United States.
hazard_text: The right-side top cap on some forks may not be adequately torqued which in some cases may lead to the top cap working itself free through riding. When this happens, the air cartridge may abruptly spring out of the stanchion tube causing a risk of injury to the rider. As of October 25, 2018, the company has received 1 report of the air cartridge springing out of the stanchion tube in Canada, and no report of injuries. In the United States, the company has received 4 reports of the air cartridge springing out of the stanchion tube resulting in 2 reports of injury.
description_text: This recall involves Öhlins branded RXF36 Air and RXF34 front air suspension forks sold as aftermarket equipment and as original equipment on some S​pecialized-branded Enduro, Stumpjumper, Fuse, and Levo mountain bicycles. A bicycle fork is the part that connects the front wheel to the frame. The recalled forks are black with "ÖHLINS" written in gold on each of the fork lowers. They have "RXF36" or "RXF34" printed across the fork arch. RXF36 Coil Forks (no air valve on the right-side top cap and "TTX" and "Coil" written on the back of the left fork lowers) are not included in this recall.

title: Pacific Cycle Recalls Adult Men's Mountain Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The downtube on the bicycles can crack, posing a fall hazard
description_text: This recall involves Schwinn Abbott Adult Men's Full Suspension Mountain Bicycles. The bicycles are black with green, yellow and blue accent colors on the downtubes. The bicycles were sold with 29 inch tires. "Schwinn" is printed in green and yellow on the downtube of the bicycle and "Abbott" is printed in blue on the top tube of the bicycle near the bicycle stem and handlebars.

title: Canyon Recalls Mountain Bikes Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
hazard_text: The chainstays can crack, which can lead to failure of the chainstay, rear wheel detachment and loss of control, posing a crash hazard.
description_text: This recall involves model year 2018 Canyon Spectral full-suspension mountain bikes with aluminum chainstays. title: Trek Bicycle Corporation recalls Bontrager and Ion accessory lights

This may pose a crash hazard. As of December 14, 2016, Trek Bicycle Corporation has received no reports of incidents or injuries in Canada.
description_text: The Bontrager Flare RT accessory light is sold individually. The light is intended as a rear light to improve visibility of the rider. The Ion 700 RT accessory light is sold in the Bontrager Transmitter Lighting Set that comes with a remote. title: Fox Factory Recalls Mountain Bike Shock Absorbers Due to Fall and Injury Hazards

title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls Cannondale Mountain Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
units_text: Approximately 917 units of the recalled bicycles were sold by authorized Cannondale Dealers across Canada, and approximately 23,000 units were sold in the United States.
hazard_text: The OPI stem/steering tube assemblies can fail, posing a risk of injury from a fall. Neither Health Canada nor Cycling Sports Group, Inc. has received any reports of consumer incidents or injuries related to the use of these bicycles.

title: Huffy Recalls Bicycles with Front Disc Brakes to Replace Quick Release Lever Due to Crash Hazard
hazard_text: An open quick release lever on the bicycle's front wheel hub can come into contact with the front disc brake assembly, causing the front wheel to come to a sudden stop or separate from the bicycle, posing a risk of injury to the rider.
description_text: The recalled products are all model year 2014 Huffy TR 745 and TR-S 740 bicycles with 27.5-inch wheels. "Huffy" is on the downtube of the frame of both bicycles and model name TR 745 or TR-S 740 is on the rear portion of the frame. The TR 745 has a green frame with model number 26504M on the bottom of the frame near the pedals. The TR-S 740 has a white frame and model number 26604M on the bottom of the frame near the pedals. Bicycles that have a green dot on the inside of the quick release lever are not included in this recall.

title: Trek Recalls Superfly Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard; Seatpost Can Crack and Break
hazard_text: The seatpost can crack and break, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves model year 2015 Trek 9.8 Superfly FS SL, X1 and XT bicycles equipped with Bontrager Approved Carbon seatposts. Recalled bicycles have a serial number ending in J or K. The serial number is located on the bottom of the bicycle frame. Superfly FS, X1 or XT is printed on the bicycle's top tube. Trek is printed on the frame downtube. "Bontrager Carbon" is printed on the seatpost.

title: Vellend Tech Inc. Recalls Breezer Downtown Bicycles
units_text: Approximately 187 bicycles were sold in Canada by independent bicycle dealers.
hazard_text: The bicycle pedal can separate from the spindle (axle) during use and cause the rider to lose control, posing a fall hazard. Neither Health Canada nor Vellend Tech Inc. has received any reports of consumer incidents or injuries related to the use of these bicycles.
description_text: This recall involves Breezer Bicycles models Downtown 3, Downtown 3-ST, Downtown 8, Downtown 8-ST, Downtown EX and Downtown EX-ST. The main frame is made of steel and has either a single or a dual water bottle mount, and the wheel sets are aluminum. The bicycles come in eight different sizes and a variety of gloss colors, including candy apple, chartreuse, chocolate, dark blue, dark green, shale and slate. The model is printed on the top tube of the bicycle. The affected models have serial numbers that begin with the following date/manufacturer codes found under the bottom bracket: WBD0, WBD1, WBD2, and WBD3.

title: Breezer Recalls Downtown Bicycles Due to Crash Hazard; Pedals Can Come Off
hazard_text: The bicycle pedal can separate from the spindle (axle) during use and cause the rider to lose control, posing a crash hazard.

title: Pedal Axle Extenders Recalled by Specialized Bicycle
units_text: About 6,500 (in addition about 380 were sold in Canada)
hazard_text: The Pedal Axle Extenders can break, and the rider can lose control, posing a fall hazard.
description_text: This recall involves Specialized Body Geometry Pedal Axle Extenders that are used to extend the outward reach of the pedals. They are sold in pairs and mount directly into the bicycle crank arms. Pedal extenders are made of stainless steel and fit a 9/16 inch pedal thread. They are labeled with an "L" and an "R".

title: Specialized Recalls Specialized Body Geometry Pedal Axle Extenders
units_text: Approximately 376 Pedal Axle Extender pairs were sold in Canada, and approximately 6,500 units were sold in the United States by Authorized Specialized Retailers.
hazard_text: Specialized Bicycle Components, Inc.’s investigation has revealed that some Pedal Axle Extenders may not have been built to specification. The affected pedal axle extenders may break, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Neither Health Canada nor Specialized has received any reports of consumer incidents or injuries related to the use of the product in Canada. In the United States, Specialized has received 10 reports of the Pedal Axle Extenders breaking, including 2 reports of minor injuries, such as scrapes and bruising.
description_text: This recall involves Pedal Axle Extenders that are used to extend the outward reach of the pedals. They are sold in pairs and mount directly into the bicycle crank arms. Pedal Axle Extenders are made of stainless steel and fit a 9/16 inch pedal thread. They are labeled with an "L" and an “R”, and the UPC is 719676767451.

title: Expanded recall: SR Suntour N.A. recalls various SR Suntour Bicycle Forks
units_text: Approximately 33,644 recalled forks were sold in Canada, and approximately 67,863 were sold in the United States.
hazard_text: If the fixing bolt breaks, the bicycle fork may not properly function as a shock absorber. The top part of the fork can separate from the bottom part of the fork if the fork is lifted from the ground, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Neither Health Canada nor SR Suntour N.A. has received any reports of consumer incidents or injuries related to the use of these bicycle forks in Canada. In the United States, SR Suntour N.A. has received 2 reports of consumer incidents involving minor injuries, such as scrapes.
description_text: This recall involves SR Suntour N.A. bicycle forks that have been incorporated into finished bicycles under the following brands: GT, Giant, INA International, Scott, Trek, Cannondale, Diamondback and Schwinn brands. The following bicycle forks are included in this recall: Model Number Size Manufacturing Serial Number Range M3010 24 11/01/2014 - 01/27/2015 K*141101 to K* 150127 26 M3020 24 26 M3030 26 27.5 29 NEX 700c XCT 20 26 27.5 29 The model number, serial number range and size are vertically etched on the bicycle fork crown. A detailed list of the specific model numbers included in the recall is on the firm’s website.

title: Bicycles with SR Suntour Bicycle Forks Recalled by SR Suntour Due to Crash Hazard
units_text: About 68,000 in the United States and 33,600 in Canada
hazard_text: The bolt that attaches the upper part of the bicycle's fork to the lower part of the fork can break or separate and cause the front wheel to come off the bicycle. This is a crash hazard for riders.
description_text: This recall involves Cannondale, Diamondback, Giant, GT, INA International, Nishiki, Schwinn, Scott and Trek brand bicycles with SR Suntour bicycle forks models M3010, M3020, M3030, NEX and XCT. The recalled forks have serial numbers in the top row beginning with "K" and ending with a number between 141101 and150127. The fork model and serial numbers are located on the back of the fork's crown. The serial number is the first row. The model number is in the second row. "SR Suntour" is printed on stickers on both sides of the fork legs. A detailed list of the specific model numbers included in the recall is on the firm's website.

title: Colnago Recalls Bicycles and Frame Kits Due to Crash Hazard
units_text: About 400 in the United States and 34 in Canada
hazard_text: The front brakes can detach from fork during use, posing a crash hazard.
description_text: This recall involves all Colnago CF10 and Colnago V1-r racing bicycles and bicycle frame kits that fit 28-inch wheels. "Colnago for Ferrari" is on the downtube and the Ferrari logo is on the seat tube of the CF10. "Colnago" is on the downtube and the Ferrari logo is on the crossbar of the V1-r. Colnago has not received any reports of consumer incidents or injuries in the United States.

title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls GT Fury Mountain Bicycles Due to Crash, Injury Hazards
hazard_text: The front wheel hub can break and cause the disc brake system to fail, posing crash and injury hazards to the consumer.
description_text: This recall involves all 2015 model year GT Fury Elite and GT Fury Expert downhill mountain bicycles. The recalled 2015 Fury Elite model is white with blue and red accents. The recalled 2015 Fury Expert model is metallic grey with lime green accents. The bicycles have front and rear disc brakes and come with rear shock absorbers and front suspensions. "Fury" is printed on the top tube, the GT logo is on the down tube and the chainstay. The model names are printed in small letters on the top tube of the bicycles near the word Fury.

title: Pedego Inc. recalls Electric Bicycle Batteries
product_form: E-bike battery, charger, or power part
units_text: Approximately 400 units were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The batteries can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Health Canada has not received any consumer reports of incidents or injuries related to the use of these batteries. Pedego Inc. has received one report of a battery overheating, resulting in minor property damage in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves 36-volt and 48-volt lithium ion rechargeable batteries. The recalled batteries were sold separately and as original equipment with Pedego electric bikes. The batteries came in two styles. One style has a silver or black metal case that measures 13 ½ inches (34 centimeters) long and 6 ½ inches (16.5 centimeters) wide and 2 ½ inches (6.25 centimeters) high with black plastic end caps and a handle. The other style has a black or white plastic case that measures about 14 inches (35.5 centimeters) long, 6 ½ inches (16.5 centimeters) wide and 2 ½ inches (6.25 centimeters) high with a red indicator lamp on one end. Serial numbers that start with 'DLG' are included in this recall. The serial number can be found on a label on the side of the batteries with metal casing and on the underside of the batteries with plastic casing.

title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Cruiser Bicycles Due to Crash Hazard
hazard_text: The bicycle's brakes can fail, posing a crash hazard.
description_text: This recall involves beach cruiser style Felt Deep Six and El Guapo model bicycles with one speed and coaster brakes. "Felt" and "Deep Six" or "El Guapo" are printed on the bicycle's frame. The Deep Six was sold in black cherry with white sidewall tires and the El Guapo was sold in matte black with white tires. The Deep Six has a serial number between YI31106188 and YI31106287. The El Guapo has a serial number between YI31106288 and YI31106387. The serial number is printed on the bicycle's bottom bracket.

title: Civia Cycles Recalls Hyland Bicycles and Aluminum Bicycle Fenders
units_text: Approximately 21 recalled units were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The fender mounting bracket can break or bend, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Neither Health Canada nor Civia Cycles has received any reports of consumer incidents or injuries related to the use of this product.
description_text: This recall involves all Civia Hyland bicycles sold with the fenders as original equipment and Civia Hyland aluminum bicycle fenders sold separately as aftermarket sets. The recalled bicycle fenders are round, size 700c x 35mm and have the Civia logo on the front and rear sides of each fender. The fender sets came in black, blue, green, olive, red and silver. Hyland bicycles came in blue, green, olive and red. The bicycles have Hyland on the top tube, Civia on the down tube and the Civia logo on the seat tube.

title: Pedego Recalls Electric Bicycle Batteries Due To Fire Hazard
product_form: E-bike battery, charger, or power part
hazard_text: The batteries can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
description_text: This recall involves 36-volt and 48-volt lithium ion rechargeable batteries sold separately and as original equipment with Pedego electric bikes. Recalled batteries of each voltage came in two styles. One style has a silver or black metal case that measures about 13 ½ inches long, 6 ½ inches wide and 2 ½ inches high, with black plastic end caps and a handle.
