title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The bicycle's fork can break, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer injuries.
description_text: The recall includes all 2011 Felt F3, F4, F5 and F75 bicycles with carbon fiber frames and carbon fiber forks. - 2011 F3 - These bicycles are satin carbon/satin white with red decals. - 2011 F4 - These bicycles are satin carbon/satin white with grey decals. - 2011 F5 - These bicycles are satin carbon/satin red or matte black with diamond shape design. - 2011 F75 - These bicycles are gloss navy. "Felt" is written across the down tube of the bicycle frame.

title: REI Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The alloy steerer tube could separate from the fork causing the rider to lose control, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
description_text: This recall involves Novara Fusion bicycles with serial numbers U95Y07321, U96Y28393, or in the sequential range of the last four digits U96Y28876 through U96Y29128. Serial numbers are located on the underside of the bike. The espresso-colored bicycles were sold in two styles, the Step Through and the Fusion. The Step Through was sold in extra small/small, while the Fusion was available in medium, large, and extra large.

title: Full Speed Ahead Gossamer BB30 Crank Sets for Bicycles
units_text: Approximately 1,280 of the recalled crank sets were sold at independent bicycle retail stores across Canada.
hazard_text: If the fixing bolt is overly tightened on the non-drive crank arm during installation, part of the bolt could crack or break. The non-drive crank arm could also crack. Either of these situations could cause the non-drive crank arm to fall off the bicycle, posing a fall or crash hazard to riders. Full Speed Ahead has received 11 reports of incidents in the United States, including 2 reports of injuries. Neither Health Canada nor Full Speed Ahead has received any reports of incidents or injuries related to the use of this product in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves the Gossamer BB30 crank set, which is the part of the bicycle that attaches to the chain and pedals (for pedaling). The recalled crank set is either painted black with "Gossamer" printed in white on the arm, or painted white with "Gossamer" printed in black on the arm. There are two drive gears on the crank arm. The recalled crank sets were assembled as original equipment on the following models of Cannondale bicycles: 2010 CAAD9 5 and CAAD9 5 Feminine 2010 Six Carbon 5 2010 Slice 4, Slice 4 Nytro, Slice 5 2010 Synapse Carbon 4, Carbon 4 Feminine, Carbon 5 2011 CAAD10 5 105, CAAD10 5 105 Feminine 2011 Slice 5, Slice 5 Womens 2011 SuperSix 5 105, SuperSix 5 105 Womens 2011 Synapse Carbon 4 Rival, Carbon 4 Rival Womens, Carbon 5 2011 CAAD8 5 105 2011 CAADX 105 Cyclocross The recalled crank sets can also be identified by the product numbers, which are found on the inside of the non-drive crank arm. Gossamer Pro BB30 CK-OS6021; Gossamer Pro Compact BB30 CK-OSC6021; Gossamer BB30 CK-OS6020;or Gossamer Compact BB30 CK-OSC6020.

title: Salsa Cycles Recalls Handlebar Stems Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The handlebar stems can crack or break, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves all CroMoto S.U.L. 25.4 and 26.0 threadless handlebar stems and all CroMoto S.U.L. 26.0 quill handlebar stems sold as individual aftermarket units after April 1, 2010. The handlebar stems are black and have the word "Salsa" painted on the extension. The recalled handlebar stems have a hash mark on the inside of the stem bar clamp area.

title: Seattle Bike Supply Recalls Redline Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The head tube can separate from the frame, causing the rider to lose control and fall. This poses a risk of serious injury.
description_text: This recall involves all 2008 Redline D640 bicycles. The bicycles were sold in black and have aluminum frames. "REDLINE" is written down the frame's tube. The model number is written on the frame's top tube.

title: Full Speed Ahead Crank Sets Used By Numerous Bicycle Manufacturers Recalled Due To Crash Hazard
hazard_text: If the fixing bolt is over-tightened on the non-drive crank arm, the bolt shoulder can crack or break. If this occurs, the non-drive arm can fall off the bicycle causing the rider to crash and suffer injuries.
description_text: A crank set is the component of the bicycle that the chain and pedals attach to for pedaling. The recalled models are either painted black with "Gossamer" printed in white on the arm or white with "Gossamer" printed in black on the arm. There are two drive gears (referred to as "double") on the crank set. The recalled crank arms were assembled as original equipment on the following bicycle models: Bianchi 2010 Sempre Ultegra Cannondale 2010 CAAD9 5, CAAD9 5 Feminine2010 Six Carbon 52010 Slice 4, Slice 4 Nytro, Slice 52010 Synapse Carbon 4, Carbon 4 Feminine, Carbon 52011 CAAD10 5 105, CAAD10 5 105 Feminine2011 Slice 5, Slice 5 Womens2011 SuperSix 5 105, SuperSix 5 105 Womens2011 Synapse Carbon 4 Rival, Carbon 4 Rival Womens, Carbon 52011 CAAD8 5 1052011 CAADX 105 Cyclocross Felt 2011 F752011 F75X Fuji 2010 ACR 1.02010 ACR 2.02010 ACR 3.0 Quintana Roo 2010 CD.0.1 Litespeed 2010 C3 Raleigh 2011 RX 1.02010 RX 1.0 Scattante 2010 CFR Comp Gossamer BB30 non-drive crank arms that are included in the recall have serial numbers beginning with 10B, 10C, and 10D. Serial numbers are located on the backside of the crank arm by pedal threads (see pictures below). Note: MegaExo model Gossamer cranksets and Gossamer BB30 cranksets with three drive gears (referred to as "triple" cranksets) are not involved in this recall.

title: Giant Recalls Anthem X 29er Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The frame can crack at the junction of the seat post and top tube, posing a fall hazard to riders.
description_text: This recall involves 2011 model year Giant Anthem X 29er 1, 2 and 3 model bicycles. The bicycles were sold in small, medium and large. "Giant" and the model name are printed on the bicycle.

title: Bicycles Recalled by Easton Sports; Seat Post Poses Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The carbon top clamp of the seat post can crack, posing a fall hazard to the user.
description_text: This recall involves bicycles with 2010 EC90 Zero seat posts. The EC90 Zero seat posts are black with red and gray graphics. "EC90" is printed on the post.

title: The Hive Announces Recall to Repair Revl Carbon Road Bicycle Brakes Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The cable clamping area of the bicycle brakes can crack over time, causing the brakes to fail. This could pose a fall or crash hazard to the cyclist.
description_text: The recall involves black Revl carbon road bicycle brakes with date codes 41B, 44B, 45B, 53B, 13C and 16C printed on the underside of the carbon brake arms. "Revl" is printed on the brake.

title: Sunrise Medical Recalls Quickie® Shark Bikes Due to Footrest Failure
hazard_text: The custom footrests can break, posing a risk of injury to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves Quickie® Shark bikes with custom footrests that are designed for use by disabled persons. Model numbers included in the recall are SB472900001 and SB471900001. Model and serials numbers are printed on the right side of the bike frame. Serial numbers included in the recall are: KS910634, KS933266, KS935245, KF130177, KF130177, KF138342, KF157355, KF182230, KF214063, KF214095, KF228670, KF230678, KF268500, KF271632, KF275166, KF341126, KF344298 and KF370981.

title: Seattle Bike Supply Recalls Bicycles and Framesets Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The bicycle fork's legs can separate from the fork crown and cause the rider to lose control, posing a fall hazard and risk of injury.
description_text: This recall involves all 2010 Redline Conquest Cyclocross bicycles and framesets. The bicycles and framesets were sold in yellow and black, and have aluminum frames and aluminum forks with aluminum steering tubes. "Redline" is printed on the bicycle frame. The bicycles are equipped with a 700C wheel and frame sizes ranging from 44cm to 60 cm.

title: Campus Cruisers Recalls Bicycles Due to Front Fork Failure
hazard_text: The bicycle's front fork can crack or break, causing a sudden loss of steering control and posing a fall hazard to bicyclists.
description_text: This recall involves Campus Cruisers' Eastside Fix model bicycles. The single speed bicycle has an aluminum frame and fork. The bicycles were sold in royal blue with a white leather seat and white gel grips on the handlebars.

title: 2009 Felt Model B12, B16, and S32 Road Bicycles
units_text: Approximately 44 of the recalled bicycles were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The bicycle's fork steer tube can break while in use, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer injuries. In Canada, neither Health Canada nor Felt Bicycles has received any reports of incidents or injuries related to the use of these bicycles. In the United States, Felt Bicycles has received seven reports of the bicycle forks breaking with minor injuries, including bumps and bruises were reported in one of the incidents.
description_text: This recall involves all 2009 Felt model B12, B16, and S32 road bicycles. 2009 Felt Model B12 - These bicycles are gloss silver/carbon and have carbon fiber frames with carbon fiber forks with aluminum steer tubes. 2009 Felt Model B16 - These bicycles are matte black/red and have carbon fiber frames with carbon fiber forks with aluminum steer tubes. 2009 Felt Model S32 - These bicycles are available in gloss white/red and have aluminum frames with carbon fiber forks with aluminum steer tubes.

title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The bicycle's fork steer tube can break, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer injuries.
description_text: The recall includes all 2009 Felt model B12, B16 and S32 road bicycles. 2009 B12 - These bicycles are gloss silver/carbon and have carbon fiber frames with carbon fiber forks with aluminum steer tubes. 2009 B16 - These bicycles are matte black/red and have carbon fiber frames with carbon fiber forks with aluminum steer tubes. 2009 S32 - These bicycles are available in gloss white/red and have aluminum frames with carbon fiber forks with aluminum steer tubes.

title: Niner Bikes Recalls Bicycle Frame Due to Crash Hazard
hazard_text: A welding deficiency can cause the bicycle frames to crack along the welds of the front triangle of the bicycle. This can cause the rider to lose control and crash.
description_text: The recalled bicycle frames include all Jet 9 models ranging sequentially from serial numbers P8001682 to P9400454. The frame is a full suspension model in the colors green, white or black. "Jet 9" and "Niner" are painted on the bicycle frame. The frame was made from 6000 series aluminum.

title: Bicycles Recalled by Nirve Sports Due to Fall Hazard
units_text: About 725 units: Red Star 100, Skulls 285 and Cannibal Chopper 340
hazard_text: The bicycle stem on the handlebars can crack and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of serious fall and injury.
description_text: This recall involves three models: Red Star, Skulls and Cannibal chopper-style bicycles with the model names printed on the chain guard. Red Star has a black finish; Skulls bear a skull graphic and come in grey and black; and Cannibal bears a dragon graphic and comes in a black finish. title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The shock absorber mount can break and the shock absorber can make contact with the wheel spokes, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves alloy seat stays on the following 2010 Specialized 26" Era and 26" Epic bicycles: 2010 Epic Marathon Carbon, 2010 Epic Marathon Frame, 2010 Epic Expert Carbon, 2010 Epic Expert, 2010 Epic Comp Carbon, 2010 Epic Comp, 2010 Era FSR Expert Carb, 2010 Era FSR Expert and 2010 Era FSR Comp.

title: Ventus Ltd™ and Ventus Team™ Bicycle Aerobars
units_text: Approximately 10 of the recalled handlebars were sold at independent bicycle retailers and by internet retailers in Canada.
hazard_text: The rubber hand grips on the aerobars can loosen or slip off during use, posing a risk of falling or other injuries to the rider. 3T has received 2 reports of incidents involving adults with minor abrasions. Neither Vittoria Industries North America/BikeMine nor Health Canada has received any reports of injuries or incidents in Canada.
description_text: This recall involves all Ventus Ltd, Ventus Ltd 17, Ventus Ltd Gold, Ventus Ltd Track, Ventus Team, and Ventus Team 17 bicycle aerobars (handlebars). The Ventus Ltd models are black with a silver stripe, and the Ventus Team models are black with a red stripe. "Ventus" and "3T" logos are on the top side of the bar, along with the model name.

title: Civia Cycles Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The bicycle fork can crack or break, posing a fall hazard to the consumer.
description_text: This recall involves all Civia Hyland bicycles sold with original equipment carbon fiber forks and all Civia Carbon forks sold as aftermarket products. The forks are black and have the word "Civia" forged into the fork dropout.

title: Ventus Bicycle Aerobars Recalled by 3T Cycling Srl Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The two rubber hand grips on the aerobars (handle bars) can loosen or slip off during use, posing a fall or injury hazard to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves all Ventus Ltd, Ventus Ltd 17, Ventus Ltd Gold, Ventus Ltd Track, Ventus Team and Ventus Team 17 bicycle aerobars. The recalled aerobar models were sold in one size and color for each model; Black with red stripe for the Team and black with silver stripe for the Ltd. The "Ventus" and "3T" logos are on the top side of the bar with the model name.

title: Do It Best Recalls Bicycle Bells Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
hazard_text: The red paint on the bicycle bells contains excessive lead levels, violating the federal lead paint standard.
description_text: This recall involves children's bicycle bells. The bells are red, black and white and has "I ? My Bike" printed on the top. The green and white packaging reads "bike bell" and "$1."

title: Bicycles and Framesets Recalled By Seattle Bike Supply Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The bicycle's fork legs can separate from the fork crown and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of serious injury if the rider falls.
description_text: This recall involves all 2010 Redline Conquest Pro Cyclocross bicycles and framesets. The bicycles and framesets were sold in pearl white/blue and have aluminum frames with carbon fiber forks and aluminum steerer tubes.

title: CO2 Bicycle Tire Inflators Sold at Walmart Recalled by Todson Inc. Due to Risk of Injury
hazard_text: The pressurized cartridge containing carbon dioxide (CO2) can forcefully separate from the pump head, posing a risk of injury to the consumer.
description_text: This recall involves Zefal CO2 bicycle tire inflators with a small pressurized carbon dioxide cartridge. The metal cartridge is threaded into the inflator head, which allows for the controlled release of carbon dioxide into the bicycle inner tube. The recalled inflators have "Zefal EZ+ CO2 inflator" printed on the front of the package. Model number 5602 and UPC number 798661556020 is printed on the back.

title: Bicycles Recalled by Easton Sports; Stem Failure Poses Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The bicycle stem can crack and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of serious injury if the rider falls.
description_text: This recall involves bicycles with EA30 stems. The EA30 stems are black with white-and-gray graphics and feature a four-bolt stem face cap. "EA30" is printed on the stem. EA30 stems sold as aftermarket items are included in this recall.

title: Schwalbe Ultremo R Bicycle Tires
units_text: Approximately 1,851 of the recalled tires were sold at Bicycle specialty stores in Canada, and on Schwalbe's website.
hazard_text: The tire layers could separate, causing the inner tube to rupture and posing a fall hazard to riders. Neither Moser Enterprises Inc. nor Health Canada has received reports of incidents or injuries related to the use of these tires.
description_text: This recall involves Ultremo R bicycle tires by Schwalbe. The recalled tires have the words "Schwalbe" and "Ultremo R" printed on the sidewall of the tires. The recalled tires can be identified by model number "HS 380".

title: Easton EA 30 Bicycle Stem
units_text: Approximately 5,100 of the recalled products were sold at Outdoor Gear Canada, Rocky Mountain, and other bicycle stores across Canada.
hazard_text: The recalled four bold Easton EA 30 stems can crack and eventually break during use, posing a fall hazard to riders. Neither Easton-Bell Sports nor Health Canada has received any incidents or injuries to Canadians related to the use of the recalled product.
description_text: This recall involves the EA 30 Model Bicycle Stems by Easton-Bell Sports, Inc. The stems are aluminum with a four bolt face plate, which is a separate plate that allows easy installation to the handlebar. The recalled stems are black and approximately 9 to 13cm (3 1/2 to 5 inches) long. The EA 30 stems were sold individually and can be identified by the following UPC numbers: UPC 76866785917 for the stem that is approximately 8cm (75mm) in length UPC 76866785924 for the stem that is approximately 9cm (90mm) in length UPC 76866785931 for the stem that is approximately 10cm (105mm) in length UPC 76866785948 for the stem that is approximately 12cm (120mm) in length The stems can also be identified by the production code located on the side of the clamp next to the lower clamping screw. The production code is comprised of the calendar month (denoted by a letter A through L) and the year (denoted by a single digit). Only the four bolt EA 30 Stems are included in this recall.

title: Electra Bicycle Company Expands Recall of Bicycles with Front Trays or Baskets; Trays and Baskets Can Come Loose and Pose Fall Hazard to Riders
units_text: About 6,400 (3,000 units were previously recalled in March 2009)
hazard_text: The front tray or basket on the bicycles can come loose and contact the front tire, posing a fall hazard to riders.
description_text: This recall involves the 2009 Delivery 3i, Delivery 8D, Holiday 3i, Holiday 8i and Surf 3i bicycles with front-mounted trays or baskets. The trays have an alloy frame with wooden slats. The baskets are wicker with a removable tote bag. The trays were sold as original equipment on the bicycles and as aftermarket items. The baskets were sold only as aftermarket items.

title: Moser Enterprises Recalls Schwalbe Brand Bicycle Tires Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The tire layers could separate causing the inner tube to rupture, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
description_text: This recall includes Schwalbe Ultremo R bicycle tires. "Schwalbe" and "Ultremo R" are printed on the sidewall of the tires.

title: 2009 Model Electra Bicycles with Trays or Baskets
units_text: Approximately 750 of the recalled products were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The front tray or basket can come loose from the fork crown and contact the front tire, posing a fall hazard to riders. The U.S. Importer, Electra Bicycle, has received thirteen reports of a front tray coming loose, two of which allegedly resulted in minor injuries, including scrapes and bruises. Electra Bicycle has also received two reports of a front basket coming loose, with no reported injuries in the U.S. only. Neither Electra Bicycle nor Health Canada has received any reports of incidents or injuries to Canadians related to the use of these bicycles.
description_text: This recall involves Trays and Baskets on 2009 Model Bicycles by Electra. The recalled 2009 bicycle models included in this recall are as follows: Delivery 3i, Delivery 8D, Holiday 3i, Holiday 8i and Surf 3i. The recall also includes after-market alloy/wood front trays and front mount wicker baskets with a removable tote bag. This recall does not include bicycles without front trays or baskets or any other Electra bicycles.

title: 10-Speed SRAM Bicycle Chains with PowerLock® connector links
product_form: E-bike battery, charger, or power part
units_text: Approximately 1,446 of the recalled products were sold at various bicycle retailers across Canada.
hazard_text: The recalled PowerLock® connector links, which are used on bicycle chains, can become brittle and can crack, allowing the chain to separate from the bicycle, posing a fall hazard to the rider. One incident has been reported in the United States and three outside of the United States, with no reported injuries. Health Canada has not received any reports of incidents or injuries to Canadian related to the use of this product.
description_text: This recall involves SRAM PowerLock® connector links. The recalled connector links were sold individually, on 10-speed bicycle chains, and on some Guru, Surly, Salsa, BMC, Serotta, Seven, and Ridley-brand complete bicycles. The recalled connector links, used to install 10-speed bicycle chains without the need for special tools, can be identified by either the letter "M" or "N", found engraved on the side of the link. In addition, 10-speed SRAM chains that have the recalled connector links have the following chain model numbers: PC-1030, PC-1050, PC-1070, PC-1090, and PC-1090R, and UPC numbers: 710845503429, 710845503405,710845503412, 710845504693, or 710845504709. The following PowerLock® connector links are not included in this recall: PowerLock® connector links for 8-speed chains and 9-speed chains older models of PowerLock® connector links any PowerLock® connector links that have a date code other than "M" or "N"

title: Bicycle Chains and Chain Connector Links Recalled by SRAM Due to Fall Hazard
product_form: E-bike battery, charger, or power part
hazard_text: The recalled PowerLock connector links, used on bicycle chains, are brittle and can crack, allowing the chain to separate from the bicycle and posing a fall hazard to the rider.
description_text: The recall involves SRAM PowerLock connector links, which are sold individually, on 10-speed bicycle chains and as original equipment on some bicycles. The recalled PowerLock connector links are identified by a date code of M or N, which is located on the side of the PowerLock connector link. 10-speed SRAM chains that were equipped with recalled PowerLock connector links include the following chain model numbers: PC-1030, PC-1050, PC-1070, PC-1090 and PC-1090R. The recalled chains were also installed on some Guru, Surly, Salsa, BMC, Serotta, Seven, and Ridley brand complete bicycles. The individual PowerLock connectors and bike chains with these connectors were sold from January 2009 through August 2009; bicycles with affected chains were sold from April 2009 through August 2009.

title: 2007/2008 Felt F1X Cyclocross Bicycles
units_text: Approximately 15 units of the recalled products were sold at independent bicycle dealers in Canada.
hazard_text: The bicycle's fork steerer tube can break, causing the rider to lose control and fall, posing a risk of injury. Felt Bicycles, the U.S. Importer, has received six reports of the bicycle forks breaking, including two reports of minor cuts and scrapes. Health Canada has not received any reports of incidents or injuries to Canadians related to the use of these bicycles.
description_text: This recall involves all 2007/2008 Felt F1X Cyclocross Bicycles. These bicycles are available in semimatte black colour and have aluminum frames with carbon fibre forks with aluminum steerer tubes.

title: Bicycles Recalled by Nirve Sports; Stem Failure Poses Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The bicycle stem can crack and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of serious injury if the rider falls.
description_text: This recall involves Cannibal "Chopper" model bicycles with graphic designs by artist Corey Miller. The bicycles have a black matte finish. The affected bicycles have a serial number within the following range: L8E0300001 - L8E1001050. Serial numbers are located on the bottom of the bicycle between the pedals.

title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Cyclocross Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The bicycle's fork steerer tube can break, causing the rider to lose control and fall, posing a risk of injury.
description_text: The recall includes all 2007/2008 Felt F1X Cyclocross Bicycles. These bicycles are available in semimatte black and have aluminum frames with carbon fiber forks with aluminum steerer tubes.

title: Bicycles Recalled by REI Due to Fork Failure
hazard_text: The fork can separate from the steerer tube which can cause the rider to lose control, posing a fall hazard.
description_text: This recall involves 2005 Novara Trionfo bicycles with Aprebic carbon fiber forks. The bicycles are blue and white with black forks, and have the name "Novara" printed on the bars.

title: Cannondale Recalls Bicycles; JD Forks Can Lose Alignment, Posing Crash Hazard
hazard_text: The recalled bicycle's fork can lose alignment causing the front wheel to turn unexpectedly. This can cause the rider to lose control of the bicycle and crash.
description_text: The recall involves model year 2008 Cannondale Adventure 2, Adventure 3, Adventure 2 Feminine and Adventure 3 Feminine bicycles. The model name is printed on the bicycle's frame. The bicycles have a suspension fork with the words "cannondale AT35 adventure trail" printed on them. Bicycles equipped with the Rock Shox i-ride fork are not included in the recall.

title: Norco Recalls Bicycle Frames Due to Crash Hazard
hazard_text: The bicycle frame can crack and separate, causing a rider to fall from the bicycle and suffer injuries.
description_text: The recalled bicycle frames include the following model year and model names: 2007 Team DH, 2008 Team DH, Aline Park, Aline, Atomik, Shore 1,2,3, 2009 Atomik (without gussets). All colors are included in the recall and the model name is printed on a decal on the top tube of each frame/bike.

title: Trek Recalls Bicycles; JD Forks Can Lose Alignment, Posing Crash Hazard
hazard_text: The recalled bicycle's fork can lose alignment causing the front wheel to turn unexpectedly. This can cause the rider to lose control of the bicycle and crash.
description_text: The recall involves model year 2009 Trek 7300, 7300WSD, and 7500 bicycles. The model name is printed on the bicycle's frame. The bicycles have a suspension fork with the words "Bontrager SPA" printed on them.

title: Dahon and REI Novara Folding Bicycles Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The hinge on the handlepost can crack, posing a fall hazard.
description_text: This recall involves model year 2008 Dahon and REI Novara folding bicycles. The models included in the recall are as follows: Dahon Ciao P8, Curve D3, Curve SL, Glide P8, Jetstream P8, Mu P8, Mu P24, MU SL, Mu XL Sport, Vitesse D7 HG, Speed D7, Speed P8, Speed TR, Speed Pro TT, Mariner D7 REI Novara Buzz FlyBy and FlyBy Shuttle The words "Dahon" or "Novara" and the model name are printed on the bicycle. Except for the Jetstream P8 and Glide P8 models, hinges with an "R" embossed on the face of the upper handlepost hinge and/or a "Radius Handlepost" sticker on the handlepost are not included in the recall. All Jetstream P8 and Glide P8 models are included in the recall unless they have an "R" embossed twice on the face of the of the lower handlepost hinge (Image 2) indicating they have been repaired.

title: 2008 Model Dahon Folding Bicycles
units_text: Approximately 1,100 of the recalled products were sold at various retailers across Canada.
hazard_text: The hinge on the handlepost can crack, posing a potential fall hazard to users. Neither Dahon nor Health Canada has received any reports of incidents or injuries relating to the use of these bicycles.
description_text: This recall involves 2008 model folding bicycles sold under the brand name "Dahon". The following models are included in this recall: 2008 Ciao P8 2008 Glide P8 2008 Jetstream P8 2008 Mu P8 2008 Mu P24 2008 Mu SL 2008 Mu XL Sport 2008 Vitesse D7 HG 2008 Speed D7 2008 Speed P8 2008 Speed TR 2008 Speed Pro TT Bicycles that have a sticker with the words "Radius Handlepost" are not included in this recall. Also, bicycles that have the letter "R" written at the base of the handlepost (see picture) are not included in this recall.

title: Norco Bicycle Frames
units_text: Approximately 1,800 of the recalled products were sold at various bicycle stores across Canada.
hazard_text: The bicycle frame can crack and separate, posing a risk of falling and injuries to the rider. Health Canada has not received any reports of incidents or injuries related to the use of these bicycles.
description_text: This recall involves several models of Norco bicycle frames. All colours are included in this recall. The recalled model names and years are: 2007 Team DH 2008 Team DH 2008 Aline Park 2008 Aline 2008 Atomik 2008 Shore 1, 2, 3 2009 Atomik (without gussets) The model name is printed on a decal on the top tube of the bike frame.

title: 2008 Cannondale Adventure Bicycles
units_text: Approximately 43 of the recalled products were sold by Cannondale bicycle dealers across Canada.
hazard_text: The recalled bicycle's suspension fork can lose alignment with the handlebar, causing the front wheel to turn unexpectedly. This can cause the rider to lose control of the bicycle and crash. Neither Cannondale Bicycle Corporation nor Health Canada has received reports of incidents or injuries to related to the use of these bicycles.
description_text: This recall involves model year 2008 Cannondale Adventure 2, Adventure 3, Adventure 2 Feminine, and Adventure 3 Feminine bicycles. The model name is printed on the bicycle frame. Printed on the suspension fork are the words "Cannondale AT35 adventure trail". 2008 Adventure 2 and 3 bicycles equipped with the Rock Shox I-ride fork are not included in this recall.

title: 2009 Trek Bicycles
units_text: Approximately 762 of the recalled products were sold at Trek bicycle dealers across Canada.
hazard_text: The recalled bicycle's suspension fork can lose alignment with the handlebar, causing the front wheel to turn unexpectedly. This can cause the rider to lose control of the bicycle and crash. Trek Bicycle Corporation has received four reports of misaligned forks, with no reports of injuries. Health Canada has not received any reports of incidents or injuries related to the use of these bicycles.
description_text: This recall involves model year 2009 Trek 7300, Trek 7300WSD, and Trek 7500 bicycles. The model name is printed on the bicycle frame. Printed on the suspension fork are the words "Bontrager SPA".

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The cable stop on the bicycle can loosen, which can cause the rider to lose control and fall from the bike.
description_text: The recalled bicycles are as follows: 2004 Roubaix Comp 18, 2004 Roubaix Comp 27, 2004 Roubaix Pro 18, and 2004 Roubaix Pro frameset models. Only bicycles with a single rivet fastening the cable stop to the frame are subject to recall. The cable stop is attached through bonding materials and a single rivet mounted at the front of the bicycle. The cables pass through eyelets in the cable stop on the down tube. Bicycles with a double rivet fastening the cable stop to the frame are not subject to recall. The model names of the recalled bicycles can be found on the top tube of the bicycles.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Serious Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The handlebars can break, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
description_text: This recall involves HL handlebars on the following 2009 Specialized bicycles: Cross Trail Comp, Myka HT Comp, Myka HT Elite, Rockhopper, Rockhopper Comp and Rockhopper Comp 29. The model number of the HL handlebar is ALR-13 NTFOV and is located underneath the right hand grip of the handlebar.

hazard_text: The bicycles fail to meet the federal safety standard for bicycles. Spoke protector discs, required on bicycles to prevent the bicycle chain from interfering or suddenly stopping the wheel, are missing from these bicycles. This poses a fall hazard to the rider.

title: Electra Bicycle Company Recalls Bicycles with Front Trays; Trays Can Come Loose and Pose Fall Hazard to Riders
hazard_text: The front tray on the bicycle can come loose and contact the front tire, posing a fall hazard to riders.
description_text: This recall involves the following Electra 2009 model bicycles: Delivery 3i, Delivery 8D, Holiday 3i and Surf 3i.

title: Handlebar Stems used on Salsa Bicycles

hazard_text: The handlebar stem can crack or break, posing a fall hazard to the consumer. Salsa Bicycles has received three reports of the handlebar stem breaking, with one incident resulting in a broken wrist. Health Canada has not received any reports of incidents or injuries regarding the use of these bicycle stems.

The stems range from a 75- to 105-degree rise, and an extension length between 90 and 120 mm. Salsa bicycles that are affected by this recall include: Ala Carte, El Mariachi, Casseroll Triple, Casseroll Single, and La Cruz. The aftermarket product is black and has the word "Salsa" painted on the extension.

units_text: Approximately 160 of the recalled products were distributed to various bicycle and sporting goods stores in Canada.
hazard_text: The missing spoke protector discs may cause the bicycle chain to interfere or suddenly stop the wheel, posing a fall hazard to the user. Neither Cannondale nor Health Canada has received any reports of incidents or injuries to Canadians related to the use of these recalled bicycles.
description_text: This recall involves 2009 model Cannondale road bicycles that have "Six" printed on the bicycle's top tube and "Cannondale" written on the down tube. hazard_text: The handlebar stems can crack or break, posing a fall hazard to the consumer.
description_text: This recall involves all CroMoto S.U.L. stems sold as individual aftermarket units and on these models of complete Salsa bicycles: Ala Carte, El Mariachi, Casseroll Triple, Casseroll Single and La Cruz. title: Marzocchi Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Crash Hazard and Risk of Injury during Repair
hazard_text: The suspension system on bikes with the recalled forks could become completely compressed and fail to return to its original position after a forceful landing. This can cause riders to lose control of the bicycle and crash. The forks can also expand forcefully if repair is attempted by the consumer, posing a risk of serious injury.
description_text: The recalled bicycle forks were sold for installation on mountain bikes. The recall involves certain 2008 model year 888RC3 and 888RC3WC suspensions with date codes beginning with T07D07, T07D08 and T07D09. The forks are white or black with red and black artwork on the legs.

title: Bicycles with R-SYS Wheel Rims Recalled by Mavic USA Due to Crash Hazard
hazard_text: The spokes on the bicycle's front wheel rim can break during use, posing a fall and crash hazard to riders.
description_text: This recall includes R-SYS and R-SYS Premium front wheel rims. They were sold as original equipment on various bicycle brands and were also sold separately. R-SYS wheel rims are designed for road bikes. "R-SYS" is printed on the front rim of the wheels. The rims are 22mm in diameter, with 16 tubular, unidirectional carbon spokes.

title: Bicycle Forks
units_text: Two units of the recalled forks were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The suspension system on bikes with the recalled forks could become completely compressed and fail to return its original position after a forceful landing. This can cause riders to lose control of the bicycle and crash. The forks can also expand forcefully if repair is attempted by the consumer, posing a risk of serious injury. The manufacturer, Tenneco-Marzocchi, has received 8 reports of damaged forks outside the U.S., including a report of an injury from a fall. Health Canada has not received any reports of incidents or injuries to Canadians related to the use of these bicycle forks.
description_text: This recall involves 2008 Marzocchi bicycle forks with model year 888RC3 and 888RC3WC suspensions having a date code beginning with T07D07, T07D08 or T07D09. The date code is located on the fork's crossbar. The bicycle forks were sold for installation on mountain bikes. The forks are white or black, with red and black artwork on the legs.

title: Mavic Bicycles with R-SYS Front Wheel
units_text: Approximately 307 units of the recalled front wheels were sold at specialty bicycle stores across Canada.
hazard_text: The carbon tubular spokes of the R-SYS front wheel may break during use under certain circumstances and cause the rider to lose control, fall and be injured. Health Canada has not received any reports of incidents or injuries related to the use of these products.
description_text: This recall involves all models of Mavic Bicycle R-SYS (including R-SYS, R-SYS test and R-SYS Premium) front wheel, whether purchased separately or as part of a bicycle.

title: RockShox Domain 302 and 318 Bicycle Forks
units_text: Approximately 370 units were available for sale at specialty bicycle retailers in Canada.
hazard_text: The steel steerer tube on the forks can crack, causing the fork to detach from the bicycle frame. This can cause the rider to lose control and crash. One incident with a minor injury has been reported in the United States. Two other incidents without injury have been reported outside of the United States. Health Canada has not received any reports of injuries or incidents related to the use of this product.
description_text: This recall involves RockShox Domain 302 and 318 bicycle forks with steel steerer tubes, sold for installation on new bicycles. Only forks manufactured between March 2008 and October 2008 having date codes starting with 09T8 and 42T8 are included in this recall. The date code is located on the back of the fork crown and on the lower leg. The RockShox Domain fork was installed on Transition Bottle Rocket bicycles, and may have been installed on Rocky Mountain Flatline 1, Rocky Mountain Slayer SS350, and Rocky Mountain Slayer SS396. Forks produced with an aluminum steerer tube are not affected by this recall.

title: Giant Bicycle, Inc. Recalls Bicycles; Fork Can Break Causing Rider To Fall
hazard_text: The density of the steerer tubes can cause the forks to crack and break, posing a fall hazard to the consumer.
description_text: This recall involves 2009 TCR Advanced SL Team, SL 0, SL 1, SL 2, and SL (ISP) model bicycles and frames in silver, charcoal, blue and red. The words "Giant" and "TCR Advanced SL" are printed on the frame. Steerer tubes with "B", "N" or "P" at the end of the serial number are not included in this recall. Other "TCR" model bicycles are not included in the recall.

title: Bicycles with RockShox Bicycle Forks Recalled by SRAM LLC Due to Crash Hazard
hazard_text: The steel steerer on the forks can crack, causing the fork to detach from the bicycle frame. This can cause the rider to lose control and crash.
description_text: The recall involves RockShox Domain 302 and 318 bicycle forks with steel steerer sold for installation on new bicycles. Only those forks manufactured between March 2008 and October 2008 with dates codes 09T8 through 42T8 are included in this recall. The date code is located on the back of the fork crown and on the lower leg. The RockShox Domain fork was installed on Transition Bottle Rocket bicycles, and may have been installed on Rocky Mountain Flatline 1, Rocky Mountain Slayer SS350, and Rocky Mountain Slayer SS396 bicycles.

title: Durin Race 80/100 Bicycle Suspension Forks
units_text: Approximately 54 of the recalled suspension forks were sold across Canada.
hazard_text: The front bicycle suspension fork can break, causing the rider to crash. Health Canada has not received reports of incidents or injuries to Canadians related to the use of these suspension forks.
description_text: The suspension fork is located on the bicycle's front wheel. They are white or black. "Magura" and "MD100R" or "MD80R" are printed on the forks.

title: Magura USA Recalls Bicycle Suspension Forks Due to Crash Hazard
hazard_text: The front bicycle suspension fork can break, causing the rider to crash.
description_text: The suspension fork is located on the bicycle's front wheel. They are white or black. "Magura" and "MD100R" or "MD80R" are printed on the forks.

title: Lithium-Ion Batteries Used with Bicycle Lights Recalled By DiNotte Lighting Due to Burn Hazard
hazard_text: A loose wiring connection and improper venting can cause the battery to overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers.
description_text: DiNotte Lighting Lithium-Ion battery with nylon bags are used with DiNotte 5W Li-Ion bicycle lights and DiNotte 3 LED police lights. The DiNotte logo is printed on the battery cable connector.

title: Shimano American Corp. Recalls Wheels for Bicycles; Flat Tire Can Pose Injury Risk to Riders
hazard_text: Rim surface and spoke hole plugs on the wheel can cause a puncture to the inner tube, resulting in a flat tire. This can cause the rider to lose control and fall.
description_text: This recall involves the Shimano Dura Ace Carbon Clincher Wheel Sets with model number WH-7850 C24CL sold for road racing bicycles. The rim has labels that read "Shimano WH-7850", "Dura Ace", and "Carbon 1380." These wheels are intended for use with high end adult road racing bicycles.

title: Bicycles with Deda Forza Handlebar Stems Recalled by Deda Elementi Due to Crash Hazard
hazard_text: The top of the bicycle handlebar stem can crack and cause the rider to lose control, posing a crash hazard.
description_text: The recall involves bicycles with Deda Forza black carbon fiber handlebar stems in gloss finish. "Deda Forza" is printed on the handlebar stem. Deda Forza black carbon fiber handlebar stems in matte finish are not included in this recall.

title: Cervelo SA Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The fork's steerer can break during normal use, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer serious injuries.
description_text: The recalled forks have a clear coating over black painted carbon fiber, with the words "Wolf Superlite" and related logo just below the crown on each fork leg, and the letters "SL" on each leg above the fork blade dropouts. There is a True Temper CRT™ logo on the inside of both fork legs. The recalled forks could have been included on the following bicycle models: R3, R3 SL, Soloist Carbon, Soloist Carbon SL, and certain P3 Carbon framesets and complete bicycles.

title: Electra Bicycle Company Expands Recall of Amsterdam Bicycles; Chain Can Derail and Pose Injury Risk to Riders
units_text: About 1,500 (This recall was first announced in July 2008)

"Electra" and "Amsterdam" are printed on the bicycle's frame and/or chainguard. Bicycles with frame numbers beginning with "EL" or bicycles with chainguards marked "06/08" are not included in this recall. The frame number is located on the underside of the bottom bracket.

title: Bicycle Pedals Recalled by Look Cycle; Pedals Can Break Causing Cyclists to Fall
hazard_text: The steel axle inside the pedal can break, posing a fall hazard to cyclists.
description_text: The recalled bicycle pedals were sold separately from bicycles. Pedal models include KéO Classic, KéO Sprint, KéO HM and KéO Carbon. The model name is printed in white on the side of the pedal. Date codes between January 2004 and December 2005 are included in this recall. The date code for the KéO Classic, Sprint and Carbon pedals is on a dial stamped onto the pedal. The date code for the KéO HM is on the bottom of the pedal, with the letters A through L corresponding to the month, and the numbers 4 and 5 indicating 2004 or 2005. "Ti" pedals are not included in this recall.

title: Kéo Bicycle Pedals
units_text: Approximately 3058 pairs of the recalled pedals were sold in Canada.
hazard_text: The steel axle inside the pedal can break, posing a fall hazard to cyclists. The U.S Distributor, Look Cycle USA, has received 14 reports of incidents with broken pedals, including 7 injuries which resulted in scrapes, cuts, contusions, elbow pain, and a knee injury. The Canadian Distributor, Kempter Marketing Inc, has received a report of one incident related this recall. Health Canada has not received reports of incidents or injuries to Canadians related to the use of these bicycle pedals.

title: True Temper Wolf SL Carbon Fiber Bicycle Forks
units_text: Approximately 1,750 ot the recalled bicycle forks were sold across Canada.

The Importer, Cervélo SA, has received three Canadian reports of fork steerers cracking or breaking, including one Canadian injury which resulted in minor abrasions and one broken wrist. Health Canada has not received reports of incidents or injuries to Canadians related to the use of these water bicycle forks.

The recalled forks could have been included on the following bicycle models: R3, R3 SL, Soloist Carbon, Soloist Carbon SL, and certain P3 Carbon framesets and complete bicycles.

title: Electra Bicycle Company Recalls Amsterdam Bicycles; Chain Can Derail and Pose Injury Risk to Riders
hazard_text: The interior alignment tabs of the bicycle's chainguard can be pushed against the chain, causing it to derail, which poses a risk of injury to riders.

"Electra" and "Amsterdam" are printed on the bicycle's frame and/or chainguard. Bicycles with frame numbers beginning with "F06" or "EL" or bicycles with chainguards marked "06/08" are not included in this recall. title: Hayes Bicycle Group Recalls Quick-Release Devices for Bicycles Due To Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The quick release devices can unexpectedly fail or break when locked in position on the bicycle, causing the rider to lose control, which poses a serious fall hazard.

These devices have hollow skewers. They were sold individually or with SunRinglé front and rear wheels with model names Black Flag, Disc o Flea, Charger, STR8 Track, Accelerator R3.00C and Accelerator T3.0C. "Ringlé" is stamped on the lever. Quick release devices with a solid skewer are not included in this recall.

title: Amsterdam Model Bicycle by Electra Bicycle Company, LLC.

hazard_text: The interior alignment tabs of the bicycle's chainguard can be pushed against the chain causing it to derail, which poses a risk of injury to riders. The U.S. importer, Electra Bicycle Company, has received four reports in North America of the chainguard derailing the chain, including one report of minor cuts and abrasion from a fall. Electra and the Canadian distributor, Revolution Sports Supply Inc., are aware of two incidents in Canada involving a dropped chain attributable to the chainguard problem. These incidents did not result in injury to the rider. Health Canada has not received any reports of incidents or injuries to Canadians related to the use of these bicycles.
description_text: This recall involves some Amsterdam model bicycles in the Classic 3, Original 3, Royal 8, and Sport 3 styles. The bicycles have an enclosed chainguard. "Electra" and "Amsterdam" are printed on the bicycle's frame and/or chainguard. hazard_text: The frame on the bicycle might have been manufactured incorrectly. A small number of the Trek model MT220 girls' bicycles were made with a frame that was welded incorrectly. hazard_text: The frame can break while in use, causing the rider to lose control and suffer injuries from a fall or collision.

title: Pacific Cycle Recalls Children's Trailer Bicycles; Can Detach from Adult Bicycle and Injure Children
hazard_text: The coupler connecting the children's trailer bike to the adult's bicycle has welds that can fail, posing a fall hazard to children.
description_text: The "Pathfinder," "Run About," and "Alley Cat" are single-wheeled, children's bicycles that connect to an adult's bicycle by a coupler. The recall includes model numbers: 12-PF250, 13-SC250, 13-SC350 and M5101. The model number is located on the lower seat tube of the frame. The affected couplers have welded plates; bicycles that have couplers with cast parts are not included in this recall.

hazard_text: The coupler connecting the children's bike trailer to the adult's bicycle has welds that can fail, posing a fall hazard to children. Only couplers that have welded plates are affected by this public notice; bike trailers that have couplers with cast parts are not included. No injuries have been reported to date.
description_text: The Schwinn Runabout bike trailer model # 04SC250 is a single-wheeled, children's bicycle that connects to an adult's bicycle by a coupler. The name "RUNABOUT" is located on the main frame of the bicycle.

title: Reynolds Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard
hazard_text: The fork tips could separate from the fork legs, causing the wheel to come loose from the fork while riding. This could pose a serious fall hazard to riders.
description_text: This recall involves the Reynolds UL bicycle fork models with 43 mm and 50 mm rakes and with serial numbers 09100 through 10403. The serial number decal is located on the steer tube. To see the serial number, the fork must be removed from the frame. Some recalled forks are black, have "Reynolds" printed on them, and have a gray and white stripe painted on the legs of the fork. Other recalled forks were painted with a different paint scheme and do not have "Reynolds" printed on them. To determine if a fork is included in this recall, consumers should contact the company.

title: Formula Brake USA Recalls Disc Brakes for Bicycles Due to Risk of Failure
hazard_text: The brake's hand lever can separate, resulting in loss of braking. This can cause the rider to lose control of the bicycle, posing a risk of injury to riders.
description_text: This recall involves Oro disk brakes typically installed on mountain bikes. The brake is operated by a hand lever, which is mounted to the handlebar. Included in the recall are the Oro K18, Oro K24, Oro Puro and Oro Bianco models with serial numbers less than 295237. The serial number can be located on the brake's body above the "Made in Italy" label.

title: Huffy Recalls Bicycles Due To Cranks Falling Off; Riders Can Lose Control of Bike
hazard_text: The bicycle crank can unexpectedly come off, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer serious injuries.

The "Howler" was sold in black (model K3587, boy's model), blue (model K4587, men's model), and red (model K6587, men's model). title: REI Recalls Children's Trailer Bicycles; Can Detach from Adult Bicycle and Injure Children

title: Raleigh America Recalls Bicycles; Forks Can Break Causing Loss of Control
